data.notes: January’s confirmed calendar was strongest in the New Year/Detty December spillover window, then shifted into showcase, live-band, and homecoming-concert programming later in the month.

events.title: Music Is My Life Concert 2026
events.summary: Free New Year’s Day concert in Tema featuring Sarkodie, Kweku Smoke, King Promise, Asakaa Boys, Mista Myles, Kimilist, Ras Kuuku, Lasmid and more. The event is presented by Mimlife Records as a major annual opener for Ghana’s concert calendar.

events.title: The Water Xperience
events.venueName: Sunset Banana Beach Resort, Lower Prampram
events.summary: New Year’s Day beach festival in Lower Prampram with performances from Yaa Pono, Tulenkey, Rashid Metal, Jay Winning, Fryday Celeb, Big Busy, Tonnah Lee and DJs including DJ Wobeti, DJ Lighter and DJ Flame. The programme also included water sports, live bands and a night beach jam.

events.title: FUEGO on the Beach – Curated by Smallgod
events.summary: Smallgod-curated late-night beach-club event at Polo Beach Club. The venue described the night as focused on Afrobeats, trap and global street sounds.

events.title: Brunch n Vibes Presents Accra
events.summary: Afrobeats edition of Brunch n Vibes in Accra, promoted as a return to BloomBar. The event ran on Friday, 2 January 2026 from 7:00 PM to 11:59 PM GMT.

events.title: One Day Only – Headie One Live
events.summary: Late-night Polo Beach Club event billed as “One Day Only – 4th January 2026,” with the page title identifying Headie One Live at Polo Beach Club. The event ran from 10:00 PM on 4 January to 4:00 AM on 5 January.

events.title: OBI’S House
events.summary: Obi’s House took over Polo Beach Club for a late-night Afrobeats party running from 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM. The listing positions it as one of the venue’s major early-January season events.

events.title: ACCRA - LIVE LIFE LARGE
events.summary: 1WAY and LTL brought the Live Life Large Africa tour to Front/Back in Osu. The DICE listing billed the event as an 18+ party with an international DJ and host lineup.

events.title: The Blackout: Amaarae Homecoming Concert
events.summary: Amaarae homecoming concert in Accra, presented with music powered by iMullar Sound System. The Chale App ticket page listed the show for 7 January 2026 from 6:20 PM to 11:00 PM.

events.title: AFROSON1C X 2026
events.summary: West Africa showcase platform and conference at Treehouse, Accra, with The Cavemen. announced as headliner. The programme combined live showcases, panels, A&R listening rooms, industry networking and a regional music-tech-arts focus.

events.title: FRA!ternity Festival 2026
events.summary: Flagship annual festival curated by Ghanaian highlife-funk band FRA!, with a 16 January workshop at the British Council and a 17 January main event at Alliance Française d’Accra. The festival centres live bands, original Ghanaian music, highlife, funk and contemporary African sounds.

data.notes: November 2026 in Accra has a light but varied confirmed calendar, with dance-culture festivals, Afrobeats concerts, recurring beach-club nights, and DJ-led nightlife ahead of Detty December.

events.title: O'Live Experience 2026
events.summary: Olivetheboy’s official site confirms O'Live Experience 2026 at the National Theatre, with gates at 6 PM and show at 7 PM. The artist is billed as an Afrobeats singer-songwriter blending Ghanaian rhythms with pop, R&B and alt influences.

events.title: FUJIFILM instax Undisputed Accra Qualifier x Afro Break Ghana
events.summary: The Undisputed world breaking series comes to Accra Mall in partnership with Afro Break Ghana, bringing continental breaking battles, DJs and MCs to Accra. The official page confirms 21 November 2026 and free entrance.

events.title: Ghana Dance Kamp 2026
events.summary: International Afro and Dancehall-focused dance camp and cultural experience in Accra, built around Afro dance styles, workshops, performances, and community programming.

events.title: Accra Kizomba Festival 2026
events.summary: A week-long Kizomba festival in Accra with DJs, instructors, workshops, bootcamps, social parties, late-night dance floors, live music and showcases. The confirmed dates run from 26 October to 1 November 2026.

events.title: Afro Wave Tuesday
events.summary: Afrikana Beach House’s recurring Tuesday night with Spinset is confirmed with a 3 November listing among its official dates. The night is billed around Afrobeats, Amapiano and hip-hop sounds at the Labadi beach venue.

events.title: melt : a smooth experience
events.summary: VAVAVOOM hosts a free golden-hour party at Kokrobite Oasis with TMSKDJ on the decks. The event is explicitly billed with Afrohouse, Afrobeats and Amapiano from 5 PM to 9 PM on 20 November 2026.

events.title: Amapiano Vibrations
events.summary: A 400-capacity ticketed amapiano rave in Accra billed as “Africa’s Biggest Amapiano Rave,” promoted by Lumis Group Africa.

events.title: The HiWave Experience
events.summary: HiWave Band presents its maiden concert and end-of-year warm-up at Pera Lounge and Bar. The eGotickets listing confirms the show for 7 November 2026, running into the early hours of 8 November.

events.title: EL Chvpo Live
events.summary: El Chvpo returns to Kona for a live show with guest artistes, Accra DJs and hype men. The event is confirmed for 7 November 2026 and billed as a new-chapter live experience for the artist.

events.title: Outside with Big Abonteng x Gona Boy
events.summary: Big Abonteng hosts an EnzoAccra night with Gona Boy live on stage, built around music, energy and party vibes. The ticketing page confirms 14 November 2026, running into 15 November.

events.title: VIBRA NOCTURNA 2k26
events.summary: VYBZ SESSION GH presents Vibra Nocturna at Coaches Lounge, a nightlife event built around jamz, music performance and games. The eGotickets page confirms 21 November 2026 from 4 PM to 4 AM the next day.

events.title: Accra Madness
events.summary: Accra Madness is a youth-culture party at Coaches Lounge with DJs, performances, fashion and entertainment. Ayatickets confirms the event for 13 November 2026 at 10:00 PM.

events.title: Groove Yard
events.summary: Groove Yard is a Gen Z-focused day-club event at East Garden Event Center with top DJs, food, drinks and social energy. The listing confirms 29 November 2026 from noon to midnight into 30 November.

events.title: Tropical Vibe
events.summary: Vibez Cafe’s Tropical Vibe returns for its second edition at the University of Ghana poolside. The confirmed 22 November 2026 event promises cocktails, smooth music and a tropical day-party setup.

events.title: Tidal Rave Fest
events.summary: AccraEvents.GH lists Tidal Rave Fest for November 14, 2026 at La Palm Royal Beach Hotel, describing it as a beach rave with music, dance, fashion, entrepreneurship, content creation, and local artistes.

data.notes: Only a few December 2026 Accra events have firm public pages so far; several usual Detty December anchors are still omitted until their 2026 dates/lineups are explicitly announced.

events.title: Accra House Fest 2026
events.summary: Transit and Open House Accra’s all-day/all-night house-music festival, billed as the alternative sound of December and Ghana’s premier platform for house culture.

events.title: ZAAMA DISCO 2026
events.summary: Black Sherif headlines the 2026 edition of Zaama Disco at Legon Sports Stadium. The event page bills it as a major Accra December live-music experience for Black Sherif’s Blacko Tribe.

events.title: HipHop Africa Festival 2026
events.summary: Hip-hop culture festival at Untamed Empire with Ghanaian rap names, cyphers, DJ showcases, beat showcases, streetwear, street art and panels.

events.title: Zumaland Music & Art Festival
events.summary: Zumaland is a two-day music and art festival confirmed for 26–27 December 2026 in Borteyman, Accra. The official page presents it as an immersive African music, culture, dance, food and art gathering.

events.title: Afro-GoGo Festival
events.summary: Six-day diaspora homecoming festival mixing live performances, rooftop parties, brunches, beach takeovers and a dedicated Amapiano vs Afrobeats DJ clash.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-night Accra December experience with a main stage, carnival zones, food village, and nightly music/nightlife programming. The music program is described around Afrobeats, Amapiano, drill, Afropop, DJs and live acts, with peak nights Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Compozers Fest Ghana Edition
events.summary: New Year’s Eve Accra edition at Pitch Accra listed as an Amapiano and Afro-house party, with R&B, hip-hop and Detty December tags.

events.title: Detty Dezemba
events.summary: A ticketed December concert billed around Afrobeats and Amapiano, with six acts planned and an 18+ format. The venue is still listed as TBA on the ticketing page.

events.title: SoftLife Party
events.summary: Christmas Eve Front/Back club night listed as an Amapiano and Afro-House party, with tags spanning hip-hop, R&B, Afrobeats and Detty December.

events.title: Dutty December Is Coming! DJ Opoku Live in Ghana
events.summary: Beach-resort day-to-night Detty December session with DJ Opoku, billed around AfroHouse, Afrobeat, Azonto and Amapiano with poolside and live-band elements.

events.title: United World Music & Film Festival
events.venueName: Accra International Conference Centre & Black Star Square
events.summary: A four-day music, film, culture, business and innovation festival in Accra, with published daily programming including live concert kickoffs, evening concert series, a “Night of Legends” concert and a closing concert.

events.title: BHIM Festival
events.summary: Stonebwoy’s BHIM Festival is listed for December 24, 2026, at Accra Sports Stadium, with a focus on Afro-Dancehall, Afrobeats, Reggae, Highlife and Dancehall traditions.

events.title: Rapperholic
events.summary: Sarkodie’s annual Rapperholic concert is listed for Christmas Day 2026 in Accra, continuing one of Ghana’s signature year-end hip-hop concert brands.

events.title: Detty Rave
events.summary: Detty Rave is confirmed for December 27, 2026, on Spintex Road, with AccraEvents describing it as a high-energy end-of-year celebration blending African music, fashion, art and culture.

events.title: AfroFuture
events.summary: AfroFuture is listed for December 28–29, 2026, at El Wak Stadium, with live performances, DJs, art, food and fashion as part of Accra’s peak Detty December window.

events.title: Promiseland Concert
events.summary: Promiseland Concert is listed for December 30, 2026, on Spintex Road; the listing confirms a music-and-culture concert format, though the 2026 supporting lineup is not yet published there.

events.title: AFROSON1C X Edition 02
events.summary: West Africa-focused showcase festival and music industry conference returning to Accra with live showcases, panels, workshops, curated meetings and expanded multi-day programming after a sold-out debut.

events.title: Tropical Fiesta V
events.summary: A three-day, two-night resort getaway/private party festival outside Accra, powered by Livewire Events, Enjoyment Radio and Black Avenue Muzik, with artists, celebrity DJs, influencers and diaspora guests.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-day Accra carnival/nightlife experience running into early January, with Afrobeats, Amapiano, drill and Afropop DJ sets, live acts, carnival rides, food and peak-night programming.

events.title: Afro Wave Tuesday

events.title: One Night In Accra
events.summary: Chaleboyz-hosted Detty-season closing club night at Enzo Accra, centered on Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Hiplife, Afrofusion and Ghanaian anthems until 5 AM.

events.title: Freedom Parade

events.title: Labadi Beach Networking Party
events.summary: A New Year beach link-up at Labadi Beach with Whizgee Ras, top DJs, late-night dancing and networking zones, running 8 PM to 5 AM.

events.title: Urban Events Global Presents: Detty December Ghana | A Curated Luxury Experience 2027
events.summary: A dated Urban Events Global Detty December Ghana diaspora experience listed for Accra; the public ticket page confirms the date and city but does not yet publish a detailed club-night lineup.

data.notes: April 2026 in Amsterdam was anchored by Easter-weekend electronic festivals, a packed King’s Day calendar, and a few major arena and club-tour concerts.

events.title: DGTL Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: DGTL returned to the NDSM-werf for a weekend of electronic music, art and production, with listed names including Dom Dolla, CamelPhat, Jayda G, I Hate Models, Gerd Janson, Luuk van Dijk and Weval live.

events.title: SPIELRAUM Weekender
events.summary: SPIELRAUM’s Easter weekender ran from Saturday night into Monday morning at CLUB RAUM. The RA-listed lineup included Bambounou, Buttechno live, Cio D’Or, Dee Diggs, livwutang, Mama Snake, Rey Colino and Tasha.

events.title: Cosmic Gate: Open To Close Amsterdam
events.summary: Cosmic Gate played an exclusive five-hour open-to-close Amsterdam show at Melkweg OZ on Easter Sunday. The event focused on the duo’s long-running trance and progressive sound.

events.title: Ratherlost Easter Sunday
events.summary: Ratherlost’s Easter Sunday edition at Lofi ran from afternoon into the next morning. Lofi’s listing named Altinbas b2b Efdemin, Oscar Mulero, Skee Mask, Polygonia, mad miran and others.

events.title: Amsterdam Calling 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Calling returned to Melkweg as a Eurovision-focused live event and party. The programme promised live performances by Eurovision stars plus DJ sets of Eurovision classics.

events.title: We are iT Festival 2026
events.summary: We are iT Festival 2026 took over Thuishaven with a Golden Age of House Music theme. The RA-listed lineup included Jean, ROOG, Erick E, Joost van Bellen, Lucien Foort, Remy Unger and Funkerman.

events.title: Minimal Music Festival 2026
events.summary: The ninth Minimal Music Festival presented four days of hypnotic minimal, contemporary and electronic-leaning performance. The programme included Bang on a Can All-Stars’ Terry Riley 90th Birthday Celebration, Sarathy Korwar, Bendik Giske + Sam Barker, Mohammad Reza Mortazavi, Julianna Barwick and Mary Lattimore.

events.title: ROSALÍA: LUX TOUR 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA brought her LUX TOUR 2026 to Ziggo Dome for two Amsterdam dates on 22 and 23 April. MOJO described the show around her modern flamenco-inflected pop, reggaeton, hip-hop and R&B sound.

events.title: Krezip
events.summary: Dutch pop band Krezip played Melkweg MAX with support from Tape Toy. Melkweg listed the show as part of Krezip’s 2026 club tour through the Netherlands and Belgium.

events.title: Lofi by Speedy J
events.summary: Lofi hosted a late-night techno session headlined by Speedy J. The venue listing also named Claudio PRC b2b Isabel Soto and Megan Leber for the Club room.

events.title: FYM x Oranjebloesem Kingsday Amsterdam
events.summary: Free Your Mind and Oranjebloesem joined forces for a King’s Day event at RAI Amsterdam from 12:00 to 22:00. RA’s listing included Sara Landry, Reinier Zonneveld live, Maddix, MALUGI, Michel de Hey and Prunk among the lineup.

events.title: Kingsland Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: Kingsland Amsterdam staged its King’s Day edition at the Olympic Stadium on 27 April 2026. The official site listed the date, venue and line-up section for the city’s large-scale orange-day pop and dance celebration.

data.notes: May 2026 in Amsterdam is anchored by Liberation Day city festivals, major electronic weekender Upclose and Lentekabinet, plus arena-scale pop residencies and tours.

events.title: HVYWGHT x Sonic Boom
events.summary: London dubstep crew HVYWGHT joined forces with Sonic Boom for its 20th anniversary edition at Melkweg. The confirmed lineup included Digital Mystikz, Mia Koden, Beatrice M., Lulá Luna, Brutuzz and Krackfree Soundsystem.

events.title: Bevrijdingsfestival Het Vrije Westen
events.summary: Amsterdam’s free Liberation Day festival in Westerpark presents ten stages of live music, DJs and cultural programming. The official programme names acts including Poptrash, Kraak & Smaak, Klezmagic, Kasba, Steve Rachmad and the Golden Jazz Cats.

events.title: Het Amsterdams Verbond
events.summary: The major Amsterdam Liberation Day stadium party returns to Olympisch Stadion with multiple stage takeovers and a broad house, pop and hip-hop programme. Confirmed artists include Bokoesam, Frenna, Idaly, Benny Rodrigues, DJ Chuckie, Girls Don’t Sync and Lucky Done Gone.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL - Europe '26
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL brought their Europe '26 show to Ziggo Dome with SG Lewis confirmed as support. Live Nation lists the Amsterdam date for Wednesday, 6 May 2026, with an additional Amsterdam date also linked from the event page.

events.title: London Calling Festival 2026
events.summary: Paradiso’s long-running discovery festival London Calling returns for two nights of new indie and alternative acts. The confirmed lineup includes Panic Shack, overpass, Meltt, Keo, Adult DVD, The New Eves, Westside Cowboy and more.

events.title: Upclose 2026
events.summary: Awakenings’ intimate techno-focused Upclose returns to Houtrak for two days. The official timetable includes Alarico b2b Ben Klock, Collabs 3000, Planetary Assault Systems, Ben UFO b2b Four Tet, Nina Kraviz, LSD live, Freddy K b2b Marrøn and many more.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together
events.summary: Harry Styles opens his Amsterdam stadium residency at Johan Cruijff ArenA, with Robyn confirmed as special guest. MOJO lists the Amsterdam run across May and early June; this entry uses the explicitly listed 16 May 2026 date as the representative May date.

events.title: Lentekabinet 2026
events.summary: Dekmantel’s Lentekabinet returns to Het Twiske for its 13th edition over Pentecost weekend. The confirmed lineup includes Honey Dijon, Hunee, DJ EZ, Job Jobse, Chris Stussy b2b Shanti Celeste, Call Super, Seth Troxler, SHERELLE, Goldie and Young Marco.

events.title: Pretty Pissed 2026
events.summary: Melkweg’s punk-leaning Pretty Pissed festival returns for a third edition across its rooms. The confirmed lineup includes Aerial Salad, C’est Qui?, Deki Alem, Hammok, Kaboutertje Putlucht, Kid Kapichi, Martial Arts, Swim School and The Meffs, followed by a Wap Shoo Wap afterparty.

events.title: FIBER Festival 2026: Fragile Forces
events.summary: FIBER’s 11th edition spans Amsterdam venues with audiovisual art, experimental electronic music, club nights, sound art concerts and talks. Confirmed music programming includes Whatever the Weather, Kara-Lis Coverdale, Batu, Piezo & upsammy, Bobby Beethoven, CORIN, KUNTARI and Abdullah Miniawy Trio.

events.title: TWICE [THIS IS FOR] WORLD TOUR IN AMSTERDAM
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE plays two consecutive Amsterdam arena shows at Ziggo Dome as part of the THIS IS FOR world tour. Ticketmaster lists confirmed performances on 30 and 31 May 2026.

data.notes: June 2026 in Amsterdam is already anchored by major outdoor electronic festivals, jazz and roots programming, and a run of large Ziggo Dome arena shows.

events.title: 909 Festival 2026
events.summary: 909 Festival returns to Amsterdamse Bos on 6 and 7 June 2026. Confirmed names include Adam Beyer, Anfisa Letyago, Fjaak x KiNK live, Mall Grab, Ben Böhmer live, Eric Prydz, Jeff Mills and Kevin Saunderson.

events.title: Holland Festival 2026
events.summary: The 79th Holland Festival runs from 3 to 28 June 2026 with 30 productions and 104 performances across 23 venues. Composer and musician Hildur Guðnadóttir is the 2026 associate artist, with music-led projects including Chernobyl, Where To From, Nærmynd and Passing Remark.

events.title: Guns N' Roses - World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N' Roses have two confirmed Ziggo Dome shows on 18 and 20 June 2026. Mammoth is listed on the lineup for the Amsterdam dates.

events.title: Amsterdam Open Air 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Open Air is confirmed at Gaasperpark on 6 and 7 June 2026. The city listing describes the two-day festival as a reflection of Amsterdam nightlife, spanning house, techno, disco, hip-hop and electro.

events.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat performs at Ziggo Dome on 12 June 2026 as part of the Tour Ma Vie World Tour. Ticketmaster lists the Amsterdam concert at 20:00.

events.title: Iron Maiden - Run For Your Live World Tour 2026
events.summary: Iron Maiden plays Ziggo Dome on 10 June 2026 on the Run For Your Live World Tour 2026. Evergrey is confirmed as support.

events.title: KAYTRANADA - EUROPE '26 TOUR
events.summary: KAYTRANADA plays Ziggo Dome on 1 June 2026 with Uncle Waffles listed on the bill. The Amsterdam date is part of his Europe '26 Tour.

events.title: FKA twigs: BODY HIGH TOUR
events.summary: FKA twigs brings the BODY HIGH TOUR to Ziggo Dome on 6 June 2026. Yves Tumor is listed as support on the Ticketmaster event page.

events.title: Red Light Jazz 2026
events.summary: Red Light Jazz 2026 runs across 5, 6 and 7 June with performances throughout Amsterdam's Red Light District. The listed programme includes artists such as Mark Beebe Trio, ACHHA, Chocos and Red Light Jazz Dinner feat. DJ + New Cool Collective.

events.title: Mystic Garden: Echo's of Amsterdam
events.summary: Mystic Garden lists Echo's of Amsterdam for 20 June 2026 at Sloterpark, Amsterdam. The event is presented as its summer edition, with tickets on sale via the official site.

events.title: PIV Festival 2026
events.summary: PIV brings its house-focused label/festival community to NDSM Docklands with Prunk, Locklead, Matisa, M-High, Kellie Allen, Kepler and more.

events.title: DKMNTL at TILLATEC
events.summary: Dekmantel brings its DKMNTL series to TILLATEC for a secret-lineup early-summer daytime dance.

events.title: LASTER x TILLATEC [Summer Edition]
events.summary: LASTER brings a heavyweight techno lineup to TILLATEC with Philippa Pacho, Sandrien, Roll Dann, Phara, Costanza and LAIA.

events.title: Quelza - all night long
events.summary: Lofi gives Berlin-based French techno artist Quelza an all-night Colorfloor session, with lights by Strobert.

events.title: DJ Bone presents: FURTHER 6th Anniversary
events.summary: DJ Bone's FURTHER marks its 6th anniversary at RADION on 6 June 2026. The RA listing confirms DJ Bone b2b Zack Fox, Ellaweeez and residents for a 23:00-07:00 night session.

events.title: Amsterdam Roots Festival 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Roots Festival is confirmed for 28 June 2026 from 13:00 to 23:00. The City of Amsterdam describes it as an event where artists and makers from around the world share cultural backgrounds through music, dance, circus and theatre.

events.title: VBX Summer Day
events.summary: Amsterdam minimal-house institution VBX hosts a daytime Lofi session led by Apollonia on an extended set, with Zino & Lorena setting the tone.

events.title: Thuishaven with Luciano / Jamback
events.summary: Thuishaven closes the June run with an open-air day party headlined by Luciano and Jamback, alongside Luke Alessi, M-High, Demi Riquisimo and more.

events.title: Joris Voorn presents Spectrum & A Trip To Galaxy
events.summary: A 15-hour Lofi day-into-night session: outdoor Spectrum showcase by day, then indoor techno under the A Trip To Galaxy banner after dark.

events.title: Agrio Club x Ritmo Fatale
events.summary: Agrio Club and Ritmo Fatale join forces at Lofi for a long indoor/outdoor marathon with Tjade, Kendal, Bella Claxton, DJ Frank, Jenny Cara and more.

events.title: Bruno Mars – The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars brings The Romantic Tour to Johan Cruijff ArenA for an Amsterdam run on July 2, 4, 5 and 7, with Anderson .Paak as DJ Pee .Wee and Victoria Monét listed as special guests.

events.title: Milkshake Festival 2026

events.summary: XLSIOR Mykonos debuts in Amsterdam on July 31 as part of WorldPride 2026 at Panama Amsterdam. The Pride Amsterdam listing names Eliad Cohen, JUNYO and Manuel Coby among the DJs for the Olympians edition.

data.notes: August 2026 is unusually dense in Amsterdam, with WorldPride spillover, major electronic festivals, classical/jazz programming, and arena pop/hip-hop shows all confirmed.

events.title: Dekmantel Festival 2026
events.venueName: Amsterdamse Bos, Melkweg, Paradiso, Oude Kerk
events.summary: Dekmantel’s 12th edition runs July 29–August 2, with 160+ electronic acts and expanded city programming. Confirmed artists include DARKSIDE, Helena Hauff, Ricardo Villalobos, Skrillex, Underground Resistance featuring Saul Williams, and Ron Trent.

events.title: Loveland Festival 2026
events.summary: Loveland Festival returns to Sloterpark on August 8–9 with a major house and techno lineup. Resident Advisor lists Eric Prydz, Fatboy Slim, Ben Klock, Sven Väth, Robert Hood, Joris Voorn, Nicole Moudaber, Hot Since 82, Sasha & John Digweed, and many more.

events.title: World Pride Music Festival
events.summary: A two-night WorldPride music event at AFAS Live, confirmed for July 31 and August 1. The venue describes the programme as featuring global headliners, DJs, and high-production performances, with the detailed timetable still unavailable.

events.title: WorldPride Closing Concert
events.summary: The closing concert for Amsterdam WorldPride’s Museumplein programme is confirmed for August 8 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet published on the source page.

events.title: Ratherlost - 24 Hours
events.summary: Ratherlost’s 20th gathering is a 24-hour full-venue Lofi ritual spanning darker techno, dubby morning grooves and sun-soaked progressive sounds, with artists including D.Dan, JakoJako live, Kangding Ray, Kia, Luke Vibert, Priori and Spekki Webu.

events.title: WorldPride UNITY Concert
events.summary: One of three large WorldPride concerts on Museumplein, confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 4 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet listed on the source page.

events.title: WorldPride Wedding Party XXL
events.summary: A WorldPride Museumplein concert event confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 6 from 18:00 to 00:00. The listing confirms the event and venue, but not the performer lineup.

events.title: Grachtenfestival 2026
events.summary: Grachtenfestival runs August 7–16 and presents young classical and jazz talent across Amsterdam. The source states that ticket sales and the programme will follow from June 19.

events.title: 12HRS Adonis x SPIELRAUM
events.summary: A 12-hour WorldPride collaboration between London queer institution Adonis and Amsterdam’s SPIELRAUM, part of CLUB RAUM’s DESIRE Pride programme.

events.title: Tropikali BY NIGHT | Worldpride Amsterdam
events.summary: Tropikali’s WorldPride closing night at Paradiso revives Rosario with Latin-spiced house/electronic sounds and Kalinichta’s Balkan, SWANA and Arabic-house energy.

events.title: SPIELRAUM ...IsBurning
events.summary: SPIELRAUM and IsBurning reunite for a WorldPride daytime Courtyard takeover at Lofi, billed for house and techno with a secret lineup.

events.title: RADION invites Gegen
events.summary: Berlin-born queer/fetish rave brand Gegen returns to RADION for WorldPride with BOYCA, Boris, Yigit, Mila Haj Kasem, Mar/us, Nymed b2b Spikey Lee and Shadysnack.

events.title: SLPFNK 15 YEAR AMS TOUR - BIRTHDAY WEEKENDER
events.summary: SlapFunk’s 15-year Amsterdam tour closes with a birthday weekender across Lofi and BRET, framed as the final stop of its anniversary club tour.

events.title: A$AP Rocky - Don’t Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky plays Ziggo Dome on August 27 at 19:30 on the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour. Ticketmaster confirms the Amsterdam date and venue.

events.title: ZeeZout Festival 2026
events.summary: ZeeZout Festival is confirmed for August 29 at Tuinen van West from 13:00 to 23:00. The lineup includes 36framez, Bad Boombox, Benwal, Carista, Dr Dubplate, Mall Grab, Naone, Surusinghe, Thelma, and more.

events.title: Bashkka curates
events.summary: A CLUB RAUM Pride-week curation by BASHKKA with 36framez, Clarisa Kimskii, Juliana Huxtable and more, positioned within RAUM’s DESIRE series.

events.title: Pride ...IsBurning
events.summary: IsBurning’s WorldPride Saturday night takeover at Lofi, billed as a hot, steamy house-and-techno Pride party with a surprise lineup.

events.title: JOJI: SOLARIS
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS tour to Ziggo Dome on August 25 at 20:00. Ticketmaster lists Joji with Tommy Richman on the Amsterdam date.

events.title: BINI: Signals World Tour
events.summary: Filipino girl group BINI brings the Signals World Tour to AFAS Live on August 30, with doors at 18:30 and showtime at 20:00. The venue page describes their sound as global pop with layered vocals in English and Tagalog.

events.title: Peaches at Club Chrome
events.summary: Peaches performs at Melkweg MAX on August 7 as part of Club Chrome, Melkweg’s WorldPride 2026 programme. The event page highlights her work as a feminist musician, producer, director, and performance artist.

data.notes: September 2026 is already anchored by major arena concerts, Concertgebouw special programs, and a packed 12 September festival weekend spanning Amsterdam urban culture and Ibiza-bred house/techno.

events.title: Parels van de Stad 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam’s urban culture festival returns to Riekerhaven for two days with 150+ artists across nine stages, including Yade Lauren, Lil Kleine, Jonna Fraser, Broederliefde, Monica Geuze and Idaly.

events.title: Circoloco Amsterdam
events.summary: Circoloco brings its Ibiza underground house and techno brand back to NDSM-werf for a daytime electronic dance festival.

events.title: Melanie Martinez: HADES: THE SACRIFICE
events.summary: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE arena tour to Ziggo Dome, presenting her cinematic alt-pop universe in Amsterdam.

events.title: Ronnie Wood and his band
events.summary: Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood plays Paradiso with his band, marking a notable return 31 years after The Rolling Stones’ 1995 Paradiso appearances.

events.title: Sona presents: &ME and Rampa
events.summary: Sona brings &ME and Rampa to Amsterdamse Bos for a daytime open-air Afro-house event, positioning a major global Afro-house draw in an Amsterdam park setting.

events.title: Phono Lake Festival
events.summary: Breakfast Club Amsterdam and Phono Lake’s one-dayer on a Sloterplas island focuses on house roots and offshoots, with Blake Baxter, Mike Dunn, Jovonn, Danny Daze, Pender Street Steppers, Louise Chen, Wah Wah Wino and more.

events.title: Stars in Concert: Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, Caro Emerald & Sonya Yoncheva
events.summary: A European Culture Prize concert bringing together Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, the Caro Emerald project, Sonya Yoncheva and the National Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands.

events.title: The Waterboys: The Fisherman’s Blues Revue featuring Steve Earle
events.summary: The Waterboys perform a special Fisherman’s Blues Revue at AFAS Live with Steve Earle and returning fiddler Steve Wickham.

events.title: Anastacia: #NTK Tour
events.summary: Anastacia performs at AFAS Live on the #NTK Tour, celebrating the 25th anniversary of her debut album Not That Kind and her greatest hits.

events.title: Hiromi & Metropole Orkest
events.summary: Pianist Hiromi joins the Metropole Orkest, conducted by Miho Hazama, for a jazz-fusion and orchestral program in the Concertgebouw Main Hall.

events.title: Old but Gold Hip Hop Party w/ Mario Winans at IJland
events.summary: Germany’s Old but Gold party brand lands at IJland for a 30+ oldschool hip-hop and R&B night with Mario Winans, Manie, Ray G, and a second-floor R&B/Dancehall/Afrobeats room by The Grapevyne Soundsystem.

events.title: Kumar Sanu & Anuradha Paudwal Live in Concert
events.summary: Bollywood playback icons Kumar Sanu and Anuradha Paudwal perform a nostalgia-focused concert at AFAS Live, presented by Raga Events.

events.title: Fairuz Our Muse, featuring Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti & Wasim Arslan
events.summary: Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti and Wasim Arslan perform a Concertgebouw tribute to Fairuz, curated as a cross-cultural homage to her repertoire.

events.title: BCCO x TRANSITION
events.summary: BCCO and TRANSITION team up for an all-night techno session at TILLATEC running 23:00–08:00, with lineup still TBA but both promoters attached on the listing.

events.title: Menno Solo: The Reunion
events.summary: Menno de Jong returns after nearly five years away for a one-night-only long-form underground trance/psytrance reunion set at WestWeelde.

events.title: Curated by Break
events.summary: Drum & bass selector Break headlines Melkweg’s Curated by night, joined by Breakage, Kira, Nymfo, VOXI & Leks and Innate MC.

events.title: Encore at Melkweg
events.summary: Encore’s long-running Dutch hip-hop and R&B club night returns to Melkweg for a late 23:59–05:00 edition, mixing hip-hop, afro, dancehall and R&B club sounds.

events.title: Blockhead, ProleteR, Arms and Sleepers
events.summary: Blockhead, ProleteR and Arms and Sleepers bring their autumn 2026 European tour to Bitterzoet for a night of instrumental hip-hop, downtempo and electronic grooves.

events.title: Strength of Unity: Cenobite Records and Ouwe Stijl is Botergeil
events.summary: A hard-edged Melkweg night from Cenobite Records and Ouwe Stijl is Botergeil, spanning hardcore with hard-techno/techno crossover names and an overnight 22:00–07:00 run.

events.title: TRIBE at Bitterzoet
events.summary: A Thursday Afro and amapiano special at Bitterzoet, billed around Afro/Caribbean riddims, amapiano, and a late club-room energy with lineup TBA.

data.notes: October 2026 is dominated by the 30th anniversary Amsterdam Dance Event, with arena-scale electronic flagships alongside Amsterdam’s warehouse, queer-club, Afro-house and Amapiano scenes.

events.title: Amsterdam Dance Event 2026 / 30 YEARS ADE
events.summary: ADE’s 30th anniversary edition runs across Amsterdam with ADE Pro, ADE Lab, ADE Festival and Arts & Culture programming. The official program lists more than 1,200 festival events across the city.

events.title: AMF: Johan Cruijff ArenA 2026
events.summary: AMF returns to Johan Cruijff ArenA with Afrojack, Amelie Lens, Armin van Buuren, ARTBAT, D-Block & S-te-Fan, David Guetta, Korolova and Marlon Hoffstadt. ADE also notes David Guetta’s Monolith show as part of the AMF stage.

events.title: Jean-Michel Jarre: Oxygène & Beyond — A Sonic Journey Celebrating 30 Years of ADE
events.summary: Jean-Michel Jarre is ADE 2026’s special guest of honour, marking ADE’s 30th anniversary and the 50th anniversary of Oxygène with an immersive AFAS Live opening concert. ADE describes the show as a landmark live event for the anniversary edition.

events.title: Gashouder Presents: Armin van Buuren & Benwal
events.summary: Gashouder opens its ADE run with Armin van Buuren and Benwal, plus IDEMI and Olive Anguz. ADE lists the night as a large-venue warehouse event running from 23:00 to 06:00.

events.title: Black Coffee: 3HRS SET — ADE 2026
events.summary: Black Coffee performs a special three-hour ADE set at Ziggo Dome. Live Nation confirms the event date, venue and headliner.

events.title: KI/KI - 5 HOURS ADE 2026
events.summary: KI/KI makes her Ziggo Dome debut during ADE 2026 with an exclusive five-hour headline show. MOJO lists the first Amsterdam date for Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 18:30, with a second date on October 23.

events.title: 10 YEARS OF STMPD RCRDS
events.summary: Martin Garrix’s STMPD RCRDS celebrates its 10th anniversary with an ADE label night at AFAS Live. ADE lists Martin Garrix, DubVision, Julian Jordan, Mesto, R3hab, Third Party, Vluarr and more on the lineup.

events.title: Fabric X Loud Contact
events.summary: Fabric and Loud Contact return to ADE with Jeff Mills, Helena Hauff, FJAAK, Binh, Gabrielle Kwarteng, Lumiere, Quelza and Quest at WestWeelde. ADE describes it as an underground club-culture night centered on techno, electro and house.

events.title: DGTL | Friday Night
events.summary: DGTL’s Friday-night ADE program at NDSM Warehouse features Joris Voorn, Kevin de Vries, Miss Monique, Nicky Elisabeth and NTO. The event focuses on melodic house and techno in DGTL’s industrial warehouse setting.

events.title: Gashouder Presents: Job Jobse
events.summary: Job Jobse plays an extended ADE set at Gashouder, joined by BASHKKA and Ryan Elliott. ADE confirms the event for Friday, October 23, from 14:00 to 22:00 and marks it sold out.

events.title: 909 x Loveland
events.summary: 909 and Loveland bring a daytime ADE edition to Mediahaven with Chris Liebing, DVS1, FJAAK, Kerri Chandler, KiNK, Len Faki, MARRØN and more. The official ADE page lists house and techno across three areas.

events.title: DGTL ADE | Shimza & Co
events.summary: Shimza curates DGTL’s Saturday daytime ADE program at NDSM Warehouse with AMÉMÉ, DESIREE, JAMIIE, Âme, Bedouin, Alex Wann and others. ADE positions it as a celebration of contemporary Afro house and global dancefloor connection.

events.title: LASTER presents KLOCKWORKS 20 YEARS - ADE 2026 - TILLATEC
events.summary: Spanish techno movement LASTER brings Klockworks’ 20-year anniversary to TILLATEC with Ben Klock, DVS1, Roll Dann, Setaoc Mass, The Lady Machine and Laia.

events.title: SPIELRAUM 55hrs
events.summary: Queer Amsterdam institution SPIELRAUM runs a 55-hour ADE marathon at club RAUM with DVS1, Rødhåd, Octo Octa, Sandrien, Mary Lake, Miss Kittin, The Hacker and many more.

events.title: SCOOTER CRUSHES ADE
events.summary: Scooter headlines Ziggo Dome during ADE with SCOOTER CRUSHES ADE. The official ADE page lists the German techno act for Sunday, October 25, from 20:00 to 23:00.

events.title: Tyla: THE A*POP WORLD TOUR
events.summary: Tyla brings THE A*POP WORLD TOUR to AFAS Live, with Royal MusiQ and Bloody Civilian listed as special guests. The AFAS Live page confirms doors at 18:30 and Tyla’s set at 21:15.

events.title: RAUM invites Clone Records
events.summary: Clone Records opens RAUM’s ADE program with a two-room takeover featuring Afra, Detroit in Effect, L.F.T., Neel, Serge and others. The official ADE listing frames it around electro, techno and house at Amsterdam’s queer-run club RAUM.

events.title: Rush Hour
events.summary: Amsterdam institution Rush Hour hosts a daytime ADE club event at Lofi. The official ADE listing places the event in disco, funk, soul and house territory.

events.title: Dockyard Festival ADE 2026 x Mystic Garden Festival
events.summary: Dockyard Festival ADE returns to Havenpark on October 24, 2026, joining forces again with Mystic Garden Festival. The official site confirms a 13:00–23:00 open-air techno and house festival.

events.title: Into the Woods ADE 2026
events.summary: Into the Woods turns NDSM-werf into an electronic dance festival during ADE, combining music, art, light installations and industrial/open-air stages. NDSM lists the event from October 23 to October 25, 2026.

events.title: Speedy J presents STOOR Live - ADE 2026
events.summary: Speedy J and the STOOR crew bring their fully improvised hardware-jam format back to Paradiso for ADE. The Saturday lineup is WSNWG x STOOR Live with JakoJako, Lady Starlight, UFO95, Rødhåd and Speedy J.

events.title: Hernan Cattaneo B2B Nick Warren 6hrs - ADE
events.summary: Hernan Cattaneo and Nick Warren play a rare six-hour back-to-back set at WestWeelde during ADE. The venue lists the event on October 21, 2026, from 20:00 to 03:00.

events.title: Paradise x Loveland - ADE 2026
events.summary: Jamie Jones’ Paradise brand links with Dutch institution Loveland for a late-night ADE takeover at Mediahaven, billed as a groove-forward house dancefloor session built for movement, atmosphere and connection.

events.title: Sasha b2b Patrice Bäumel - 6hrs ADE
events.summary: Watt Events and Het Sieraad host a six-hour ADE daytime back-to-back from Sasha and Patrice Bäumel, billed as a recurring Saturday reference point for long-form progressive house and quality electronic music.

events.title: Fat Freddy's Drop
events.summary: Fat Freddy’s Drop play Paradiso’s Main Hall as part of a three-night Amsterdam run. The New Zealand band’s live sound blends reggae, dub, soul, techno and jazz, including material from Based On A True Story.

events.title: The Gardens of Babylon: The Seekers of Light ADE 2026 - Sunday
events.summary: The Gardens of Babylon returns to WestWeelde during ADE with its Seekers of Light showcase trilogy. The Sunday event is confirmed for October 25, 2026, from 15:30 to 03:00 across De Unie, De Wester, De Liefde and Het Restaurant.

events.title: Ritter Butzke & Casa ADE Cruise
events.summary: Berlin club brand Ritter Butzke and Casa Productions return with a seven-hour ADE boat party on Supperclub Cruise, featuring Einmusik, Super Flu, Prismode & Solvane, Markus Klee, Malouna and Cris-H across progressive and afro-house sounds.

events.title: Loreen - THE WILDFIRE TOUR
events.summary: Loreen brings THE WILDFIRE TOUR to Paradiso’s Main Hall, with doors at 19:00 and the main programme at 20:30. The show follows her new 2026 release and highlights her Eurovision-winning pop catalogue.

events.title: Dimitri & ISIS ADE 2026
events.summary: All-day-long ADE outing from Dutch house and techno pioneers Dimitri Kneppers and ISIS at Kaap Amsterdam, aimed at heads who want local lineage rather than a stadium-scale lineup.

events.title: OUTKZT ADE 2026
events.summary: A 12-hour limited-capacity techno and acid showcase aboard Het Veronica Schip during ADE, presented by a coalition including Berlin Records, MainGround Music, Tragedie Berlin, Kraftek and Align CNTRL, with ArioVistus, Belocca, DA SEYKO, DEROZ, Kay Wagner, Ozzy Riot, Teenage Mutants and TheKoosy.

events.title: ENDLESS x ADE
events.summary: Barcelona-origin techno concept ENDLESS brings Lino Fuso live to John Doe for an ADE closing-night session, emphasizing underground culture, live performance and minimal/techno energy.

events.title: KRAFT ADE 2026 Premium Pounding Techno
events.summary: ADE edition of KRAFT’s peak-time techno gathering at Lagerwal, with TheKoosy announced and more TBA; a focused alternative to larger hard-techno rooms for older-school acid and techno heads.

events.title: KRAFT Premium Pounding Techno
events.summary: Daytime/early-evening peak-time techno session in Lagerwal’s intimate NDSM bunker setup, with Zazz+, Avis Vox, TheKoosy and DJ Jordan; the listing notes a 300-capacity style room and a classic/melodic techno focus rather than hard-techno hype.

data.notes: April 2027 is already anchored by major arena concerts, Melkweg electronic club nights, Paradiso/Tolhuistuin live-music programming, and King's Day festival activity, with more underground lineups likely to be announced closer to the date.

events.title: Kingsland Festival Amsterdam 2027
events.summary: Kingsland is confirmed at Olympisch Stadion on King's Day, 27 April 2027, from 12:00 to 20:30. The venue describes it as a King's Day music festival with live performances by well-known artists and DJs, with the program still to follow.

events.title: Eurovision in Concert 2027
events.summary: Amsterdam's large Eurovision pre-party returns to AFAS Live on 3 April 2027, presenting artists slated for the May 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. The venue confirms the show date and ticket sale details.

events.title: New Wave All Stars
events.summary: New Wave returns to Ziggo Dome with an All Stars show featuring hits, new material and guest artists. The Ziggo Dome event page confirms the 22 April 2027 show and lists additional April dates for the run.

events.title: Chef'Special
events.summary: Chef'Special play two sold-out AFAS Live shows on 16 and 17 April 2027. The venue describes the run as the band's final performance in its current line-up before guitarist Guido Joseph leaves and the group pauses.

events.title: Thirty Seconds to Mars — A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War
events.summary: Thirty Seconds to Mars bring their A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War tour to AFAS Live on 25 April 2027. The venue confirms the show date and frames the tour around the band's 2005 and 2009 albums.

events.title: We Are iT Festival 2027 - The Golden Age of House 89/00
events.summary: A 3-stage, 3,000-capacity daytime festival at Thuishaven celebrating the late-80s/90s golden age of house, with Erick E, Marcello, Dimitri Kneppers, ISIS and Alexander Koning listed.

events.title: Brandi Carlile — The Human Tour
events.summary: Brandi Carlile's AFAS Live date has been moved to 2 April 2027, with KT Tunstall listed as support. The venue page confirms tickets remain valid for the new date.

events.title: The Wombats — Twenty Years Of A Guide To Love, Loss & Desperation
events.summary: The Wombats play Gashouder Amsterdam on 7 April 2027 with The Snuts in support. MOJO confirms the date, venue, 20:00 start time and Ticketmaster sales route.

events.title: High Tea Indoor Festeaval 2027
events.summary: High Tea and Melkweg present the third edition of their indoor drum & bass festival on 10 April 2027. The event is confirmed across seven Melkweg areas, with the lineup still TBA.

events.title: KRAFT Kingsday Festival 2027: Premium Pounding Techno
events.summary: KRAFT’s King's Day techno festival at Lagerwal is confirmed for 13:00–20:00 with techno and acid listed; lineup is TBA.

events.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela
events.summary: Mexican guitar duo Rodrigo y Gabriela play Paradiso's Main Hall on 14 April 2027. Paradiso confirms the date, venue room and a 20:30 main programme.

events.title: Elba Ramalho
events.summary: Brazilian singer Elba Ramalho is confirmed at Melkweg OZ on 21 April 2027. The venue describes a set rooted in MPB and forró from the two-time Latin Grammy winner.

events.title: Ilse DeLange
events.summary: Ilse DeLange closes a three-city Dutch venue run at AFAS Live on 24 April 2027 with her full live band. The AFAS Live timetable lists doors at 18:30 and the performance at 20:30.

events.title: Jools Holland and his Rhythm & Blues Orchestra
events.summary: Jools Holland brings his Rhythm & Blues Orchestra to Paradiso's Main Hall on 9 April 2027 with Pauline Black, Ruby Turner, Louise Marshall and Sumudu Jayatilaka. The program lists a 20:30 main performance.

events.title: Jake Bugg — Alamo UK & European Tour
events.summary: Jake Bugg brings the Alamo UK & European Tour to Melkweg MAX on 16 April 2027. The venue lists the show at 19:00 and frames Bugg as a key British folk/indie singer-songwriter.

events.title: Joy Oladokun
events.summary: Joy Oladokun plays Paradiso's Main Hall on 18 April 2027 as part of the Sugar Mountain series. Paradiso highlights her Nigerian-rooted collaborators and the new album Hope Is A Heavy Thing.

events.title: Kandace Springs
events.summary: Soul-jazz singer and pianist Kandace Springs plays Tolhuistuin's Club on 26 April 2027. Paradiso confirms the date, 20:30 main programme and lineup listing for Springs.

data.notes: May 2027 is already anchored by Music On and Awakenings Upclose, with Amsterdam’s confirmed calendar also showing pop, R&B, indie and diaspora club programming across major venues.

events.title: Awakenings Upclose 2027
events.summary: Awakenings Upclose returns to Houtrak in Spaarnwoude-park on 15–16 May, running 12:00–23:00 each day. Lineup is still TBA, but the official Awakenings page confirms the dates, venue and regular ticket sale timing.

events.title: Music On Festival 2027
events.summary: Music On Festival returns for a two-day 10-year anniversary edition; the official FAQ says all artists from the cancelled 2026 lineup have reconfirmed for 2027. Confirmed names include Marco Carola, AMÉMÉ, Franky Rizardo, Dennis Cruz, Ilario Alicante, Luciano, Mason Collective and Sosa.

events.title: Gracie Abrams - The Look at My Life Tour
events.summary: Gracie Abrams begins a three-show Ziggo Dome run on 7 May, with additional dates listed for 8 and 10 May. Jake Minch is confirmed as special guest for The Look at My Life Tour.

events.title: 10 Years of Jorja Smith
events.summary: Jorja Smith performs 10 Years of Jorja Smith at Ziggo Dome on 26 May. Ticketmaster lists the Amsterdam concert at 20:00 and identifies the genre as soul.

events.title: Lentekabinet 2027
events.summary: Dekmantel’s spring festival returns to Het Twiske just north of Amsterdam, pairing adventurous electronic music with art, performance, and local creative partners.

events.title: Het Amsterdams Verbond 2027
events.summary: Het Amsterdams Verbond returns on Liberation Day, bringing Amsterdam nightlife culture to the Olympic Stadium. The official site confirms the festival for 5 May 2027 and frames it as a large freedom celebration with dancing and city-wide collectivity.

events.title: Hilary Duff - the lucky me tour
events.summary: Hilary Duff brings the lucky me tour to Ziggo Dome on 17 May, with Rebecca Black listed in the lineup. Ticketmaster lists the Amsterdam show at 19:30.

events.title: Rod Stewart - The Final Encore
events.summary: Rod Stewart brings The Final Encore to Ziggo Dome on 28 May. Live Nation lists the show at 20:00 with Rod Stewart as headliner.

events.title: Angèle - Instinct Tour
events.summary: Angèle brings her Instinct Tour to AFAS Live on 11 May. The venue page notes the tour supports her Instinct era, with an electronic core and a new large-scale stage show.

events.title: Liberté Liberté 2027
events.summary: ZeeZout’s Liberation Day day-into-night session returns to Lofi with an inside/outside format; lineup is still TBA, but the promoter and date are confirmed.

events.title: Craig David
events.summary: Craig David plays AFAS Live on 12 May 2027. The venue page highlights his UK garage/R&B legacy and the global success of his TS5 live concept.

events.title: Weezer - The Gathering Tour
events.summary: Weezer play AFAS Live on 26 May as part of The Gathering Tour, with Taking Back Sunday listed as support. The AFAS page confirms the Amsterdam date and notes the tour supports Weezer's 2026 self-titled album.

events.title: SOMBR - You Are The Reason Tour
events.summary: SOMBR plays Ziggo Dome on 31 May as part of the You Are The Reason Tour. Ticketmaster lists Ravyn Lenae and Jessie Mazin in the Amsterdam lineup.

events.title: Loreen - THE WILDFIRE TOUR
events.summary: Loreen brings THE WILDFIRE TOUR to Paradiso Main Hall on 25 May, with doors at 19:00 and main programme at 20:30. Paradiso notes the date is a rescheduled show and that existing tickets remain valid.

events.title: Island Vibes Festival 2027
events.summary: A new 1,100-capacity Caribbean/reggae day festival at IJLAND, advertised with roots reggae, lovers rock, dancehall, island classics, DJs, food, and market programming.

events.title: James Marriott - World Tour 2027
events.summary: James Marriott plays Melkweg MAX on 15 May as part of World Tour 2027. The venue bills him as a British singer-songwriter with energetic indie-rock and pop songwriting.

events.title: Jeangu Macrooy - Zolang Ik Blijf Dansen Album Presentatie
events.summary: Jeangu Macrooy presents his Dutch-language album Zolang Ik Blijf Dansen at Melkweg MAX on 22 May. Melkweg tags the show as electronic, pop and R&B, and notes a club-oriented collaboration with DJ Joost van Bellen.

data.notes: June 2027 already has a strong confirmed electronic spine, led by 909 Festival, Tropikali and Luminosity’s 20-year trance week, with arena pop and Latin touring dates filling the month.

events.title: Luminosity Beach Festival 2027 — 20 Year Anniversary
events.summary: Luminosity’s flagship beach festival returns to Zandvoort for a four-day 20th-anniversary edition, positioned as the culmination of a full week of trance-focused celebrations around Amsterdam.

events.title: 909 Festival 2027
events.summary: 909 Festival returns to Amsterdamse Bos for two days, continuing its music-first techno and house identity built around the spirit of the Roland TR-909.

events.title: Don Omar — The Last King World Tour 2027
events.summary: Reggaeton heavyweight Don Omar plays Ziggo Dome on The Last King World Tour 2027, with the venue highlighting classics such as “Danza Kuduro,” “Dale Don Dale,” “Salió El Sol” and “Bandoleros.”

events.title: Tropikali Festival 2027
events.summary: Tropikali returns to NDSM for edition N 9, with its Kalinichta, Latinichta, SECRETO and Rosario stages focused on queer community, global sounds, Latin rhythms, Balkan and SWANA influences, disco and electronic music.

events.title: Luminosity 20 Year Anniversary — Paradiso
events.summary: Luminosity marks 20 years with a daytime-to-evening anniversary event at Paradiso, bringing its global trance community into one of Amsterdam’s landmark music venues.

events.title: Festifest
events.summary: Annual intimate house, disco and italo festival at NDSM Wharf/Noorderlicht, listed with three stages and a 5,000-person visitor cap.

events.title: SOMBR — You Are The Reason Tour
events.summary: SOMBR plays Ziggo Dome as part of the You Are The Reason Tour, with Ravyn Lenae and Jessie Mazin listed as support acts on the Live Nation event page.

events.title: Hayley Williams — The Hayley Williams Show
