events.title: Crobar Be Techno pres. Pan-Pot
events.summary: Crobar Be Techno hosted Berlin duo Pan-Pot for a five-hour set on March 20, with Juaan also on the bill. Resident Advisor lists the event at Crobar Buenos Aires.

events.title: Soda Stereo – Ecos
events.summary: Soda Stereo’s “Ecos” shows were listed for March 21 and 22 at Movistar Arena. The production reunited Charly Alberti and Zeta Bosio with Gustavo Cerati’s image and voice through stage technology.

events.title: AC/DC – Power Up Tour
events.summary: AC/DC’s official tour archive listed three sold-out Buenos Aires stadium dates at Estadio River Plate: March 23, 27, and 31. The shows were part of the band’s “Power Up” tour.

events.title: Dread Mar I – 20 Años Tour
events.summary: Dread Mar I celebrated 20 years with a Buenos Aires concert at Movistar Arena on March 27. The listing says Mariano Castro’s set marked two decades of his reggae career and included material from “A Tempo.”

events.title: Tan Biónica – El Regreso en Vélez
events.summary: Tan Biónica’s official city listing confirms three Vélez Sarsfield stadium nights, with March 29 added after the March 27 and 28 shows sold out. The concerts formed a major Buenos Aires run for the reunited Argentine pop-rock band.

events.title: Crobar Be Techno pres. YellowHeads
events.summary: Crobar Be Techno closed the month with YellowHeads on March 27, alongside D3fai and Unlighted b2b Gonzalo F. Resident Advisor lists the night as a Crobar event in collaboration with External.

data.notes: April 2026 mixed arena-scale Latin/pop and rock concerts with a strong electronic slate led by Sunsetstrip, Punta Carrasco and Groove club nights.

events.title: Emanero - Todo por un beso Tour 2026
events.summary: Emanero brought his Todo por un beso Tour 2026 to Movistar Arena, presenting his new conceptual album and a large-scale stage production.

events.title: Fito Páez - Sale el Sol Tour 2026
events.summary: Fito Páez returned to Buenos Aires with the Sale el Sol Tour 2026, combining career-defining songs with material from his recent album Novela.

events.title: Sunsetstrip Buenos Aires with Hernán Cattaneo
events.summary: Hernán Cattaneo's flagship Sunsetstrip event returned to Ciudad Universitaria for two sunset-focused electronic music dates.

events.title: Deckhaus presenta: Cassian
events.summary: Deckhaus hosted Australian DJ/producer Cassian at Punta Carrasco for a late-night melodic house and techno event.

events.title: Sebastián Yatra - Entre Tanta Gente Tour
events.summary: Sebastián Yatra brought the Latin American leg of his Entre Tanta Gente Tour to Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires.

events.title: Roxette
events.summary: Roxette's new-era live show came to Movistar Arena, with Per Gessle and Lena Philipsson performing the band's classic catalog.

events.title: Jorge Drexler - TARACÁ
events.summary: Jorge Drexler played two Movistar Arena dates presenting his album TARACÁ, with candombe-informed arrangements and a seven-musician band.

events.title: Dream Theater
events.summary: Progressive metal band Dream Theater played Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires, with Songkick listing the show for fans of metal and rock.

events.title: No Te Va a Gustar - Florece en el caos
events.summary: Uruguayan band No Te Va a Gustar presented Florece en el caos at Estadio Ferro Carril Oeste, launching an extensive Argentina and international tour cycle.

events.title: Utopic pres.: T78 3 HOURS, Kessler (AR) & ALYOSHA
events.summary: Utopic brought Italian techno artist T78 to Groove Palermo for a three-hour set with local support from Kessler (AR) and ALYOSHA.

events.title: The Lumineers - The Automatic Tour
events.summary: The Lumineers played Buenos Aires on The Automatic tour at Estadio Malvinas Argentinas in Paternal.

events.title: Paradoks & More Artists by DUSK & Deckhaus
events.summary: DUSK and Deckhaus closed April at Oasis, Punta Carrasco with Paradoks, BAEZ & SAINT and Maximiliano on a progressive house and techno bill.

data.notes: November is unusually strong for Buenos Aires, with Primavera Sound and Creamfields anchoring the month while club programming leans heavily into techno, house and global club sounds.

events.title: Creamfields Argentina 2026
events.summary: Creamfields Argentina returns to Parque de la Ciudad on 14 November 2026. Confirmed names reported for the edition include Charlotte de Witte, FISHER, Hugel, The Blessed Madonna, Anfisa Letyago, Sven Väth, Kölsch and Faithless Sound System.

events.title: Primavera Sound Buenos Aires 2026
events.summary: Primavera Sound’s Buenos Aires return is confirmed for 28–29 November 2026. The announced bill is led by Gorillaz and The Strokes, with FKA twigs, Yung Lean, Lily Allen, Courtney Barnett, CMAT, Nation of Language, Juana Molina and Santiago Motorizado among the broader lineup.

events.title: Ed Sheeran - LOOP Tour
events.summary: Ed Sheeran’s official site lists Buenos Aires on 29 November at Tomás Adolfo Ducó Stadium. Livepass confirms the Huracán stadium show as part of his LOOP Tour, with FINNEAS O’Connell announced as international guest.

events.title: Romeo Santos & Prince Royce
events.summary: Romeo Santos and Prince Royce are confirmed together at Estadio Vélez Sarsfield on 14 November. The show is tied to their collaborative Better Late Than Never project and is positioned as a major bachata stadium date.

events.title: Michael Bibi B3B PAWSA B3B Dennis Cruz - Solid Grooves
events.summary: Solid Grooves is listed for Arena Norte, Núñez on 21 November. RA confirms a B3B lineup of Michael Bibi, PAWSA and Dennis Cruz, focused on house and tech house.

events.title: María Becerra - Quimera Tour 360°
events.summary: María Becerra’s official tour page lists multiple sold-out Buenos Aires dates at Movistar Arena in November, beginning on 13 November. This entry represents the first November Buenos Aires date of her Quimera tour run.

events.title: República Folklore
events.summary: The official Buenos Aires tourism site confirms República Folklore for 21–22 November 2026 at Parque de la Ciudad. The festival is billed as a large new gathering for Argentine popular song and folklore traditions.

events.title: RAVE3000 / I Hate Models, Cloudy, KUKO, Serafina, Kessler, THD+N
events.summary: RAVE3000 stages an open-air hard-techno, schranz and bounce event at Native Beach Club with I Hate Models, Cloudy, KUKO, Serafina, Kessler and THD+N, including transfer options from Capital.

events.title: CHIRI - Kenny Larkin - Robert Hood - Under Club
events.summary: Under Club lists Detroit techno figures Kenny Larkin and Robert Hood with CHIRI on 22 November. The RA event page tags the night as techno.

events.title: Cypress Hill
events.summary: Cypress Hill’s official tour listings show Buenos Aires on 8 November at Estadio Malvinas Argentinas. The date brings the veteran Los Angeles hip-hop group to the city during their 2026 world tour.

events.title: [PRIDE] MISSA ORGULLO 2026
events.summary: MISSA BA’s Pride weekend closing party is confirmed at Blow on 8 November. The lineup includes Rumi de Baires, Tina Disco, Camila Isabel, panko and Rumanians across house and techno.

events.title: Jorja Smith at C Art Media
events.summary: Passline’s C Art Media calendar lists Jorja Smith on 11 November 2026. The booking adds an R&B and soul headline show to the month’s club- and festival-heavy calendar.

events.title: WADE at Mandarine Park
events.summary: WADE brings an all-night tech-house-focused date to Mandarine Park, with official ticketing routed through Bombo and the venue listed on Costanera Rafael Obligado.

events.title: Utopic pres. NIKOLINA + ALT8 + BYØRN + ADHILA
events.summary: Utopic brings NIKOLINA, ALT8, BYØRN and ADHILA to Groove on 21 November. The promoter describes the night as schranz, hard techno and bounce.

events.title: Nora En Pure - 2gthr, Archi Club Open Air
events.summary: 2gthr and ALLMusicParties list Nora En Pure for an open-air night at Archi Club on 7 November. RA confirms Anhauser and Nicolás Leonelli on support, with deep-house programming.

events.title: Hot Chip at C Art Media
events.summary: Passline’s C Art Media calendar lists Hot Chip on 24 November 2026. The UK group’s Buenos Aires date fits the city’s strong appetite for electronic-leaning live bands and DJ-adjacent pop.

events.title: Sébastien Léger Extended Set
events.summary: Somos Produce brings Sébastien Léger to AMK club for an extended late-night set in a 2,000-capacity room, positioned as a strong melodic/progressive house night.

events.title: A Perfect Circle + Puscifer
events.summary: A Perfect Circle returns to Buenos Aires on 28 November 2026 at Microestadio Malvinas Argentinas, with Puscifer announced as the opening act. The show is billed as part of the band’s 2026 world tour.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti — Una Historia Importante World Tour 2026
events.summary: Eros Ramazzotti brings his Una Historia Importante World Tour 2026 to Movistar Arena on 28 November 2026. The Argentina date is promoted by Ake Music with tickets via Movistar Arena.

events.title: Jorja Smith — Falling or Flying Tour
events.summary: Jorja Smith is listed for C Complejo Art Media on 11 November 2026, with the event noted as a rescheduled Buenos Aires date. Expect a contemporary R&B and pop-focused live set.

events.title: Opeth — The Last Will and Testament Latin American Tour Part 2
events.summary: Opeth’s Latin American Tour Part 2 lists Buenos Aires at Teatro Gran Rivadavia on 3 November 2026. The Swedish progressive metal band is touring behind The Last Will and Testament.

data.notes: December 2026 is led by big Latin and urban arena/stadium dates, while the strongest travel-worthy club programming clusters around Costanera open-air electronic events and Niceto’s indie/underground calendar.

events.title: Maná — Vivir Sin Aire Tour
events.summary: The official promoter release confirms Maná at Estadio River Plate on December 10, 2026, for the Vivir Sin Aire Tour. The Buenos Aires stadium date is billed as the band’s only Argentina show of 2026.

events.title: New Order + Tricky
events.summary: New Order’s official tour schedule lists a Buenos Aires date at Mandarine Park on December 1, 2026, with Tricky also billed on local event listings. The booking is a major alternative/electronic-rock draw for the month.

events.title: RAVE3000 Festival 2026
events.summary: Repitch Republic’s RAVE3000 closes the year with a 12-hour, multi-stage outdoor festival spanning hard techno, house, trance, pop and Buenos Aires alternative club culture, with Arca, Patrick Mason, Cera Khin, Cristobal Pesce, LESSSS, Kessler and more listed.

events.title: Anuel AA en Argentina 2026
events.summary: The official Linke-Arte ticketing page confirms Anuel AA at Tecnópolis on December 3, 5 and 6, 2026, at 21:30. The run is a major Latin trap/reggaeton booking just outside the city line in Villa Martelli.

events.title: Omar Courtz — Por Si Mañana No Estoy World Tour
events.summary: Movistar Arena’s official event page confirms Omar Courtz on December 2, 3 and 4, 2026, following an additional November 30 date. The Puerto Rican urbano artist brings the Por Si Mañana No Estoy tour to one of Buenos Aires’ main indoor arenas.

events.title: NO ART Buenos Aires: ANOTR, Prospa, Mateo Dufour, Ludmila Di Pasquale
events.summary: Amsterdam house label and touring party brand NO ART makes its Argentina debut at Ciudad Universitaria, led by ANOTR with Prospa plus local selectors Mateo Dufour and Ludmila Di Pasquale.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Live Nation confirms Daniel Caesar’s Son of Spergy Tour at Estadio Obras in Buenos Aires on Saturday, December 5, 2026. It is the month’s strongest confirmed R&B booking.

events.title: Paul van Dyk with Ferry Corsten
events.summary: Sold Out confirms Paul van Dyk at Oasis Open Air on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with Ferry Corsten listed on the lineup. The event is promoted by Sunrise and runs overnight from 00:00 to 06:00.

events.title: #8D Cumple ATR — Damas Gratis en Vivo
events.summary: Passline’s Museum Live venue page lists “#8D cumple ATR - Damas Gratis en Vivo” on December 8, 2026, at 21:00. The cumbia villera institution is a signature Buenos Aires-area live pick for the month.

events.title: Saramalacara — La Ejecución Pública
events.summary: CoolCo’s ticketing page confirms Saramalacara at Estadio Obras Sanitarias on December 18, 2026, from 21:00 to 23:00. The show closes the Mataderos World Tour 2026 with a career-spanning performance titled La Ejecución Pública.

events.title: PM Pres. Green Velvet
events.summary: Sold Out confirms PM Pres. Green Velvet at Oasis Open Air on Friday, December 4, 2026, running from 00:00 to 07:00. The lineup page lists Green Velvet with PM Open Air and Fragment as promoters.

events.title: Korolova pres. Captive Soul at FCN
events.summary: Korolova brings the Captive Soul concept to Foro Costanera Norte for a late-night melodic/progressive electronic session.

events.title: Shintaro Sakamoto en Niceto Club
events.summary: El Cartel’s event page confirms Shintaro Sakamoto at Niceto Club on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, from 20:00 to 23:59. The listing frames the show around his psychedelic, funky solo-pop catalog and new album material.

events.title: Sara Hebe presenta Negocionismo
events.summary: Indie Hoy confirms Sara Hebe at Niceto Club on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 20:00. The Buenos Aires rapper returns to present her seventh studio album, Negocionismo, with Sylvia Pop and DJs opening.

events.title: Mushroom Christmas Edition
events.summary: Mushroom’s Christmas Edition is listed as a holiday electronic party at the Estadio Nacional de Beisbol in Ezeiza, extending the Buenos Aires metro club calendar into Christmas night.

events.title: Jay de Lys at Río Electronic Music
events.summary: Buenos Aires tech-house date for Jay de Lys at Río Electronic Music, listed by local electronic-ticketing platforms for the December club calendar.

events.title: BABYMETAL WORLD TOUR 2026 LATIN AMERICA in Buenos Aires
events.summary: BABYMETAL’s official tour page lists a Buenos Aires stop at Movistar Arena on December 1, 2026 as part of the Latin America run. Ticket sale windows are also listed on the official page.

events.title: Tan Biónica en Estadio Uno
events.summary: Livepass confirms Tan Biónica at Estadio UNO in La Plata on December 12, 2026 at 21:00, billing it as the band’s closing show of 2026. La Plata is just outside Buenos Aires and functions as a major regional stadium stop.

events.title: Rata Blanca at Movistar Arena
events.summary: Songkick lists Rata Blanca as headliner at Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires on December 2, 2026. The show is a major hometown arena date for the Argentine hard rock/heavy metal band.

events.title: Tarja Turunen — The Spirit of Christmas 2026
events.summary: Tarja Turunen’s official site confirms a Buenos Aires concert at Teatro Coliseo on December 1, 2026. The show is tied to her The Spirit of Christmas 2026 presentation.

events.title: Dominguinho en Argentina
events.summary: Brazilian project Dominguinho—featuring João Gomes, Jota.Pê and Mestrinho—makes its first Argentina appearance at C Art Media, a notable Brazilian/Latin diaspora booking outside the arena circuit.

events.title: Gerónimo Rauch at Teatro Gran Rex
events.summary: TuEntrada’s official sales page confirms Gerónimo Rauch at Teatro Gran Rex on December 10, 2026 at 20:30. The concert is listed as a Buenos Aires date for the Argentine musical-theatre vocalist.

events.title: DM Experience at Teatro Gran Rex
events.summary: TuEntrada’s official sales page confirms DM Experience at Teatro Gran Rex on December 18, 2026 at 20:00. The Gran Rex booking makes it a solid theatre-scale pick for Depeche Mode/electronic-pop fans.

events.title: Fiesta en Barco | De Pary Aloha
events.summary: A tropical-themed end-of-year boat party with dinner, navigation and dancing aboard a catamaran, programming cachengue, cumbia, old-school reggaeton and Brazilian music for a small-capacity river-party crowd.

data.notes: January 2027’s confirmed calendar is still sparse, but it already has a notable psych/alt festival play plus arena-scale classic rock, pop, and international metal/rock tours.

events.title: Rush – Fifty Something Tour
events.summary: Rush’s official tour page confirms the Fifty Something Tour date at Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires on January 15, 2027.

events.title: Levitation Argentina 2027
events.summary: Levitation’s first Argentina edition is confirmed for January 20, 2027 in Buenos Aires, with Melvins, Osees, Boris, Frankie and the Witch Fingers, and Winona Riders announced on the bill.

events.title: Freya Skye – Stars Align Tour
events.summary: Freya Skye’s official tour page lists a Buenos Aires date at C Art Media on January 25, 2027 as part of her 2027 international tour routing.

events.title: Oostil x Bob Tosh x Temple Gate x Mushroom NYE
events.summary: Mushroom’s post-NYE melodic-techno event in Ezeiza, with Oostil, Bob Tosh and Temple Gate listed for 02:00 on January 1.

events.title: Avatar at Teatro Flores
events.summary: Swedish metal band Avatar plays Teatro Flores, with the event page listing Wednesday, January 13, 2027 at 19:00.

events.title: Geoff Tate’s Operation: Mindcrime – The Final Chapter
events.summary: Geoff Tate brings his Operation: Mindcrime – The Final Chapter show to Vorterix in Buenos Aires on January 14, 2027 at 19:00, according to his official tour page.

events.title: Crashdïet – South America Tour 2027
events.summary: Crashdïet’s Buenos Aires stop on the South America Tour 2027 is confirmed at El Teatrito for Friday, January 29, 2027 at 18:00.

data.notes: February 2027 is currently strongest for stadium and arena concerts; major Buenos Aires electronic club calendars do not yet show solid February confirmations.

events.title: Karol G — Viajando Por El Mundo / Tropitour
events.summary: Karol G brings her Viajando Por El Mundo – Tropitour to Estadio River Plate, her first show at the venue. The city event page lists the concert for 5 February 2027 at 21:00.

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour
events.summary: Foo Fighters play Estadio River Plate on 25 February 2027 with Usted Señalemelo and Pacifica as local openers. The listing places the show within the band’s Take Cover Tour.

events.title: María Becerra — Quimera Tour
events.summary: María Becerra adds a Buenos Aires Movistar Arena date to her Quimera tour. Her official site lists the 06/02 Buenos Aires show with a Movistar Arena ticket link.

events.title: Tan Biónica — Movistar Arena run
events.summary: Tan Biónica return to Movistar Arena for two Buenos Aires shows on 11 and 12 February 2027. The listing frames the run around their classics and newer El Regreso material.

events.title: Jack Johnson — SURFILMUSIC Tour
events.summary: Jack Johnson plays Movistar Arena on the SURFILMUSIC Tour, with doors and show time listed on his official tour page. The Buenos Aires date is part of his South American run.

events.title: Reik
events.summary: Mexican pop trio Reik play Movistar Arena Buenos Aires on 14 February 2027. LEB Entertainment’s official shows page lists the Buenos Aires date among the group’s Argentina/Uruguay run.

events.title: Sin Bandera — Escenas Tour
events.summary: Sin Bandera bring their Escenas Tour to Movistar Arena Buenos Aires on 27 February 2027. LEB Entertainment lists the date as part of the duo’s regional itinerary.

events.title: Donavon Frankenreiter with Hendrix Frankenreiter
events.summary: Donavon Frankenreiter plays a Valentine’s Day headline show at Niceto Club with Hendrix Frankenreiter opening. The event is listed for 14 February 2027 at Niceto Club.

events.title: Lebanon Hanover
events.summary: Confirmed Buenos Aires date for the cult coldwave/darkwave duo, promoted within the Gothic BA orbit and aimed at the city's synth, goth and dark electronic scene.

events.title: Bragolin y Carrellee en Argentina
events.summary: Gothic BA-linked darkwave/minimal-synth bill pairing Bragolin with Carrellee at Marquee Session Live, a niche touring date for Buenos Aires' goth and electronic underground.

data.notes: March 2027 is anchored by Lollapalooza Argentina, with arena-scale Latin pop, nostalgia dance, reggae/rock crossovers and select club/electronic shows around it.

events.title: Lollapalooza Argentina 2027
events.summary: The official festival FAQ confirms Lollapalooza Argentina for 12–14 March 2027 at Hipódromo de San Isidro, with three days, five stages and more than 100 bands.

events.title: La Oreja de Van Gogh — Tantas Cosas Que Contar Tour
events.summary: La Oreja de Van Gogh are confirmed for three Movistar Arena shows on 19, 20 and 21 March 2027, with Amaia Montero back as vocalist for the Tantas Cosas Que Contar tour.

events.title: Love The 90s Argentina 2027
events.summary: Love The 90s Argentina is confirmed for 13 March 2027 at Movistar Arena, with a eurodance and 90s-pop lineup including Eiffel 65, 2 Unlimited, Reel 2 Real, Londonbeat, Real McCoy and El Símbolo.

events.title: Emiliano Demarco - Mandarine Park / Punta Carrasco
events.summary: A large-format all-night progressive/melodic house and techno event for Argentine DJ/producer Emiliano Demarco at the Punta Carrasco/Mandarine Park complex, presented by Elements and Circus.

events.title: Placebo — 30th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Placebo are confirmed for 3 March 2027 at Estadio Malvinas Argentinas in Buenos Aires as part of their 30th Anniversary Tour.

events.title: Cabaret Voltaire
events.summary: Cabaret Voltaire make their first Argentina appearance on 4 March 2027 at Niceto Club, with Stephen Mallinder and Chris Watson revisiting the group’s industrial and electronic catalogue.

events.title: Paralamas + Nonpalidece
events.summary: Nonpalidece and Os Paralamas do Sucesso share Movistar Arena on 23 March 2027 for a first joint Buenos Aires show built around reggae, rock, ska and Latin American roots.

events.title: Kasabian
events.summary: Kasabian return to Buenos Aires on 23 March 2027 at C Art Media, presenting Act III alongside catalogue staples such as “Club Foot” and “Fire.”

events.title: Ha*Ash — No Me Hablen de Amor Tour
events.summary: Ha*Ash return to Movistar Arena on 17 March 2027 with their No Me Hablen de Amor Latin American tour, mixing new material with more than two decades of hits.

events.title: Ultra Sunn en Argentina
events.summary: Gothic BA brings Brussels darkwave/EBM duo Ultra Sunn to Marquee Session Live, a strong niche electronic booking connecting new beat, EBM and industrial club sounds.

data.notes: Ultra Buenos Aires anchors April’s travel calendar, with several confirmed arena-scale pop, rock, Latin and electronic concerts around the same period.

events.title: Ultra Buenos Aires 2027
events.summary: Ultra Buenos Aires is confirmed for Friday April 2 and Saturday April 3, 2027. The 2027 lineup had not been announced on the checked event page, but the confirmed two-day Ultra/RESISTANCE-format festival is the month’s flagship electronic event.

events.title: Tan Biónica at Movistar Arena
events.summary: Tan Biónica return to Movistar Arena for two confirmed April shows on April 24 and April 25, 2027. The venue page says the concerts combine the band’s classic catalog with songs from El Regreso.

events.title: Jungle with Sports
events.summary: Jungle play Movistar Arena on April 1 with Sports opening. The Buenos Aires city listing describes the show as a live presentation of Jungle’s album Sunshine, blending soul, funk and electronic music.

events.title: Louis Tomlinson: How Did We Get Here? Latin America Tour
events.summary: Louis Tomlinson brings the How Did We Get Here? Latin America Tour to Movistar Arena on April 2, 2027. Live Nation lists Tomlinson as the headliner for the Buenos Aires date.

events.title: Pixies
events.summary: Pixies are confirmed at Movistar Arena on April 4, 2027. The venue page lists doors at 19:00 and show time at 21:00.

events.title: Luis Fonsi: Mar Infinito World Tour
events.summary: Luis Fonsi plays Movistar Arena on April 13, 2027 as part of the Mar Infinito World Tour. The venue page says the set will cover Fonsi’s Latin pop hits including “Despacito,” “Échame la Culpa” and newer material.

events.title: Slash featuring Myles Kennedy and The Conspirators
events.summary: Slash featuring Myles Kennedy and The Conspirators are listed for Movistar Arena on April 7, 2027. Songkick identifies the Buenos Aires concert as part of the Flying Blind-era tour activity.

data.notes: Cape Town’s January 2026 calendar was strongest in open-air summer concerts, beachfront electronic parties, jazz, and large-format holiday-weekend festivals.

events.title: DAYONE NYD feat. Miss Monique
events.summary: Music People’s New Year’s Day event at CABO Beach Club was headlined by Miss Monique, with Henri Bergmann, Argia, Amare, Anthea Scholtz, Bloem, Cody Hoff, Shugi, Sonic Bloom and others across two dance floors.

events.title: WAV Festival by Afro Nation
events.summary: Afro Nation’s R&B-focused WAV Festival took place at Green Point Track, with Mariah the Scientist, Wale, Kelvin Momo, Shekhinah, Langa Mavuso and Kujenga listed among the artists.

events.title: Milk and Cookies Festival South Africa 2026 | Cape Town
events.summary: The Cape Town edition of Milk + Cookies was an outdoor multigenre festival at HollywoodBets Kenilworth Racecourse, billed around music, food and community with amapiano, R&B, house and hip-hop sounds.

events.title: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts: GoldFish
events.summary: GoldFish played the Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts series, bringing their live-instrument electronic house sound to the garden stage from 17:15 to 19:00.

events.title: TR3S feat. Caiiro B3B Da Capo B3B Enoo Napa
events.summary: TR3S brought Caiiro, Da Capo and Enoo Napa together for a back-to-back Afro-house and Afro-tech event at CABO Beach Club.

events.title: St Tropez presents: Uncle Waffles
events.summary: St Tropez’s daytime CABO Beach Club party was headlined by Uncle Waffles, running from 15:00 until midnight at the V&A Waterfront venue.

events.title: Cape Town Minstrels Carnival / Hollywoodbets Cape Town Street Parade
events.venueName: Somerset Road and Fan Walk, Green Point
events.summary: The Cape Town Minstrels Carnival returned on 5 January 2026, with troupes marching through the city in costume while performing ghoema music on banjos, trumpets and drums.

events.title: Jazzathon 2026: The People’s Festival
events.summary: The Cape Town Jazzathon 2026 Summer Showcase ran for three days at the V&A Waterfront Amphitheatre, with listed performers including The Artscape Youth Jazz Band, Alistar Izobell, The Cape Horns, Chadleigh Gowar and Gospel According to Jazzathon.

events.title: fabric South Africa 2026 - Cape Town
events.summary: fabric London returned to Cape Town for a day-into-night festival at The Castle of Good Hope, with Marcel Dettmann, Gerd Janson, Horse Meat Disco and Gabrielle Kwarteng leading a three-room lineup.

events.title: Calum Scott - The Avenoir Tour - Cape Town
events.summary: Calum Scott brought The Avenoir Tour to Kirstenbosch Botanical Garden for a 19:00 Cape Town concert.

events.title: Sheer City - Cape Town
events.summary: Sheer City launched as a multi-venue inner-city festival around Harrington Street, with Horse Meat Disco, Esa, Tama Sumo & Lakuti, Freudenthal, Make A Dance, Thor Rixon and many Cape Town selectors on the lineup.

events.title: CTIJF presents Jazz Rising | Grand Africa
events.summary: Produced by espAfrika, the team behind the Cape Town International Jazz Festival, Jazz Rising featured Kujenga, Francesca Biancoli, Chadleigh Gowar, Daddy’s House, Clint L and Fundi at Grand Africa Café & Beach.

data.notes: February 2026 leaned heavily into summer outdoor concerts, beach-club house parties and a strong end-of-month electronic programme.

events.title: Liquideep at Cabo Beach Club
events.summary: Liquideep returned after an 11-year hiatus for a Cape Town beach-club show at Cabo Beach Club. The bill was presented by AnythingGoes with house and afro-house as the listed genres.

events.title: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts: Cape Town Philharmonic Orchestra
events.summary: The Cape Town Philharmonic Orchestra performed at Kirstenbosch with German bandoneon specialist Lothar Hensel. The programme included Astor Piazzolla selections and works by Villa-Lobos and De Falla.

events.title: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts: Msaki & The ALTBLK>>Africa Collective
events.summary: Msaki presented The ALT BLK Collective at Kirstenbosch for a Sunday summer concert. SANBI billed the performance as a new-dimensional collective set with eight musicians from across the African continent.

events.title: Franschhoek Chamber Music Festival
events.summary: The fifth Franschhoek Chamber Music Festival featured 10 concerts over four days by Cape Town Philharmonic Orchestra musicians and guests including Ariane Haering, Miclen LaiPang and Lothar Hensel. The programme ran at the Dutch Reformed Church in Franschhoek, a Cape Winelands town near Cape Town.

events.title: Paradisco: Love Sensation
events.summary: Paradisco’s Valentine’s edition at Grand Africa Café & Beach was headlined by DISCO DOM, with Floyd Lavine, The Disco Pirates, Jenica, Los Jetsons, Claudia and others on the posted set times. The party ran across beach, disco and vanity-room stages from afternoon into the early morning.

events.title: V: Bloodlust
events.summary: Incognito Events staged its anti-Valentine vampire-themed club event in Paarden Eiland. The DJ line-up listed Inge Beckmann, Zsa Zsa, Archy, Vixen and HAEZER, alongside performance elements and installations.

events.title: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts: Jeremy Loops

events.summary: C0DE Lisbon brings back UK hard-techno act Ragetrain for a dark, high-pressure club night at República da Música.

events.title: Gentleman – Live 2026
events.summary: German reggae artist Gentleman returns to Portugal with Gentleman – Live 2026 at LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 18. The venue listing highlights his album Mad World and confirms a 21:30 start.

data.notes: May 2027 is still early in the announcement cycle, but Lisbon already has a confirmed mix of arena Lusophone pop, electronic-adjacent concerts, Cascais festival programming, and a nearby YARD season opener.

events.title: Coala Festival Portugal 2027
events.summary: Coala Festival Portugal returns to Cascais for its 4th edition, with the official site confirming two open-air days across two stages and a Brazil–Portugal–Africa Lusophone focus; lineup is still to be announced.

events.title: YARD Festival 2027
events.summary: YARD’s 2027 season ticket page confirms YARD Festival across May 27, 28, 29 and 30 as the opening music chapter of its 2027 season near Lisbon.

events.title: Calema — Raízes 360 Tour
events.summary: Calema bring the Raízes 360 Tour to Lisbon’s MEO Arena, with a 360-degree stage format placing António and Fradique at the center of the room.

events.title: Soul Fusion Portugal 2027
events.summary: Seven-night deep and soulful underground house music holiday based in Alvor, with beach parties, pool parties, club events, beach-club sessions and cruise parties across the Algarve coast near Portimão.

events.title: RY X — DUSK Tour
events.summary: RY X returns to Portugal to present DUSK alongside material from across his catalogue, with the Coliseu listing highlighting his electronic and cross-disciplinary approach to performance.

events.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela — OurHome Tour
events.summary: The Grammy-winning Mexican guitar duo Rodrigo y Gabriela return to Portugal for a Lisbon date at Cineteatro Capitólio, presenting the OurHome world tour.

events.title: The Block Party Weekender 2027
events.summary: UK-rooted Block Party brand’s first Portugal weekender, with four days of themed parties, poolside events, beach parties and boat-party programming; listed genres include Afrobeats, Dancehall, Soca, Amapiano, Afro House, Baile Funk, Garage, Funky House, Hip-Hop and R&B.

events.title: The Interrupters @ Lisboa 2027
events.summary: Los Angeles ska-punk band The Interrupters return to Lisbon for a confirmed LAV show promoted by LX Droogs after their 2024 Portugal debut.

events.title: Takeoff Weekender - Albufeira 2027
events.summary: Four-day Algarve diaspora weekender with beach parties, pool parties, themed events, brunches and club nights; the stated music policy covers R&B, hip-hop, dancehall, soca, Afrobeats, Amapiano, house and funky sounds.

events.title: Original Enigma Voices
events.summary: Original Enigma Voices brings a live production built around the musical universe of Enigma to Coliseu dos Recreios, combining music, lighting, dance and immersive staging.

events.title: PANTUÃ | Mariana Dionísio
events.summary: Mariana Dionísio leads PANTUÃ, a voice-and-percussion quintet at CCB described as moving between hypnosis, ecstasy and celebratory ritual.

data.notes: June 2027 is already anchored by beach-electronic festivals around Costa da Caparica, Afro Nation’s Portimão week, and several major Lisbon arena/stadium concerts.

events.title: Afro Nation Portugal 2027
events.summary: Afro Nation Portugal returns to Praia da Rocha from June 9–11, 2027. The first wave confirms Davido, Rema and Fally Ipupa as headliners, with Omah Lay, Shenseea, Valiant, Victony, Kabza De Small and TxC also announced.

events.title: Karol G - Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
events.summary: Karol G brings the Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour to Estádio da Luz, with doors at 16:00 and show time at 19:00. Live Nation lists Karol G as the headliner for the June 18, 2027 Lisbon stadium date.

events.title: Afro Break Portugal 2027 - No.1 ANP Party Experience
events.summary: SBWORLD's week-long Afro Nation-adjacent takeover in Portimão, with beach, pool, boat, brunch and after-party programming across venues including Clube Naval de Portimão, BVSE Club, Green Heart, Riade Alvor View and more.

events.title: MOGA Caparica 2027
events.summary: MOGA returns to Costa da Caparica, just south of Lisbon, with free OFF programming on June 2–3 and ticketed beach-festival days on June 4–6. The 2027 blind-pass listing confirms a house-focused mood spanning deep house, tech house, afro house and house.

events.title: Suncébeat New Horizons Lisbon Portugal 17-21 June 2027
events.summary: A four-day-and-night house-focused beach gathering based at Irmão in Costa da Caparica, with afterparties at Waikiki and multiple boat parties; genres include House, Afro House, Deep House, Chicago House, Disco House and R&B.

events.title: Afro Nation Portugal 2027 Opening Party
events.summary: Afro Nation confirms an official Opening Party on June 8, the night before the main Portimão beach festival begins. The add-on ticket page identifies NoSoloÁgua Pool as the venue for the opening/closing party package.

events.title: Afro Nation Portugal 2027 Closing Party
events.summary: Afro Nation confirms its official Closing Party for June 12, immediately after the three festival days at Praia da Rocha. The add-on ticket page identifies NoSoloÁgua Pool as the venue for the opening/closing party package.

events.title: Luan Santana | Registro Histórico
events.summary: Luan Santana closes the Registro Histórico tour at Estádio da Luz in Lisbon. Benfica’s venue announcement and official ticketing list the concert for June 26, 2027.

events.title: Patti Smith Quartet
events.summary: Patti Smith returns to Lisbon with her quartet for a one-night Coliseu dos Recreios concert. The ticket listing confirms June 15, 2027 at 21:00 and describes a repertoire spanning rock, punk and poetry.

events.title: Simply Red - Summer Funk ’27 | Lisboa
events.summary: Simply Red play MEO Arena on the Summer Funk ’27 tour, their first Portugal appearance in nearly two decades according to the ticket listing. The Lisbon show is confirmed for June 16, 2027 at 21:00.

events.title: SUPER: Chancha Via Circuito + Ritmos Cholulteka
events.summary: Casa Capitão’s SUPER series hosts Chancha Via Circuito and Ritmos Cholulteka on June 18, 2027. Resident Advisor lists the night as Latin Bass, with the Argentine producer celebrating 20 years of his cumbia-digital project.

events.title: SKIN OUT Pool Party (Afronation Week)
events.summary: Third edition of VIILLAGERS' SKIN OUT poolside party during Afro Nation week, with an extended afternoon-to-night format and a soundtrack advertised as Afrobeats, Amapiano and Dancehall.

events.title: All White Affair Boat Party (Afronation Week)
events.summary: VIILLAGERS' all-white Afro Nation Week boat party, billed for Afrobeats, Amapiano, Dancehall, Shatta and Zouk on the water from Clube Naval de Portimão.

events.title: Grace Évora | Show Carreira
events.summary: Cape Verdean artist Grace Évora plays a career-celebration concert at Coliseu dos Recreios, revisiting songs from more than three decades of work. The event is confirmed for June 5, 2027 at 21:30.

events.title: Rep Your Flag Boat Party (Afronation Week)
events.summary: A VIILLAGERS culture-and-flag boat party minutes from Praia da Rocha, promising non-stop Afrobeats, Amapiano, Dancehall and global sounds during Afro Nation Friday.

events.title: Biso Na Biso Boat Party (Afronation Week)
events.summary: A Congolese diaspora boat party from VIILLAGERS, centred on Afrobeats, Soukouss, Congolese sounds, Ndombolo and global vibes from Clube Naval de Portimão.

events.title: The Best of Ute Lemper
events.summary: Ute Lemper brings a retrospective concert to CCB’s Grande Auditório, drawing on chanson, tango, cabaret and jazz-adjacent repertoire. The BOL listing confirms the June 8, 2027 date at 20:00.

events.title: FU<K AMAPIANO x AFROBEATS Boat Party (AFRONAT1ON)
events.venueName: Sunset Plaza Marina / Marina de Portimão
events.summary: AFROPLUG's small-capacity pre-Afro Nation Day 1 boat party from Marina de Portimão, explicitly billed as 100% Amapiano vs Afrobeats with a South African DJ and BYOB cruise format.

data.notes: July 2027 is already anchored by NOS Alive in Algés plus major Latin/Brazilian arena-scale concerts; Portimão’s flagship Afro Nation edition is confirmed for June rather than July.

events.title: NOS Alive 2027
events.summary: NOS Alive’s 19th edition is confirmed for July 8–10 at Passeio Marítimo de Algés. Early official announcements include Tame Impala on the NOS Stage on July 10.

events.title: Don Omar — The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Reggaeton figure Don Omar brings The Last King World Tour to Lisbon’s MEO Arena on July 22, with the show billed around two decades of hits including “Dale Don Dale” and “Danza Kuduro.”

events.title: Pedro Sampaio
events.summary: Brazilian DJ/producer Pedro Sampaio plays an exclusive Portugal concert at Passeio Marítimo de Algés on July 17, bringing funk carioca, pop and electronic production to a large outdoor summer setting.

events.title: Lisbon Choral Festival 2027 with Dr. Cameron LaBarr
events.summary: Perform International’s Lisbon Choral Festival runs June 29–July 3, 2027, with Dr. Cameron F. LaBarr leading a festival choir in concert with a Portuguese chamber orchestra and pianist/organist Parker Payne. The organizer states the concert program will be performed in one of Lisbon’s historic churches; the exact venue is not yet named.

data.notes: January 2026 was especially strong for London club programming, with E1, fabric, KOKO and Night Tales all running notable electronic nights alongside arena-scale pop and pop-punk concerts.

events.title: E1⁷: Blackworks invites 999999999
events.summary: Blackworks brought Italian techno duo 999999999 to E1 as part of the venue’s E1⁷ birthday programming. The lineup also listed Alja Al Saadi, Arman John, AVCI, AMMARA and Dexphase.

events.title: E1⁷: Pan-Pot All Night Long (The Grand Closing)
events.summary: Pan-Pot played an all-night-long techno set at E1 for the grand closing of the venue’s seventh-birthday celebrations. The event was promoted by E1 and Crowded London.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Dave Lee
events.summary: KOKO Electronic hosted Z Records founder Dave Lee for a house and disco-led Friday night at KOKO. The venue billed the show as Lee’s return to the theatre with special guests TBA.

events.title: Metalheadz Residency: Grooverider, Loxy, Digital, Chinese Daughter + more
events.summary: A representative date from Metalheadz’s four-Friday January residency at Night Tales, celebrating three decades of the drum & bass label. The 9 January lineup featured Grooverider, Loxy, Digital, Chinese Daughter, Diverge and Cleveland Watkiss.

events.title: Origins x BCCO - future.666, ÜBERKIKZ, SHDW
events.summary: Origins and BCCO presented a techno-focused night at fabric with future.666, ÜBERKIKZ and SHDW. DICE listed the event for 16 January 2026 at fabric.

events.title: Sasson & Mont Rouge
events.summary: KOKO Electronic hosted Paris-born DJ and producer Sasson alongside Swiss trio Mont Rouge. The venue described the sound as deep, Afro and melodic house.

events.title: ALIVE: Lee Ann Roberts, Parfait, DJ Hyperdrive
events.summary: E1’s ALIVE series booked Lee Ann Roberts, Parfait and DJ Hyperdrive for a hard techno night. The RA listing also included Becky Stroke, Cristian Collodoro and Hortense de Beauharnais.

events.title: All Time Low: EVERYONE'S TALKING! TOUR
events.summary: All Time Low brought the EVERYONE'S TALKING! TOUR to The O2 arena. The venue listing named Mayday Parade and Taylor Acorn as special guests.

events.title: Murda Live in London
events.summary: Dutch-Turkish rapper Murda performed at indigo at The O2. The O2 listing highlighted his hits in the Netherlands and Türkiye and noted collaborations with artists including Tion Wayne, Ezhel and Mero.

events.title: Agnes
events.summary: Swedish pop artist Agnes returned to London for a KOKO show featuring hits such as “Release Me,” “Fingers Crossed” and “Here Comes The Night.” KOKO billed it as a disco-pop performance.

events.title: For All Of Us: Technimatic
events.summary: Technimatic brought the For All Of Us event to KOKO for a daytime drum & bass session. The event page described the party as a celebration of soulful, uplifting drum & bass.

events.title: Jason Derulo
events.summary: Jason Derulo’s The Last Dance UK arena tour stopped at The O2 arena. The venue listed Thera and LZ7 as special guests.

data.notes: February 2026 in London was especially strong for electronic music, with major warehouse-scale Drumsheds shows, fabric programming, KOKO club nights, and big-room concerts.

events.title: ANOTR at KOKO
events.summary: Dutch house duo ANOTR played a one-off KOKO Electronic night, with the venue billing it as an intimate return after sold-out shows.

events.title: fabric Continuum: Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza, Daria Kolosova
events.summary: fabric’s first Continuum of 2026 ran as a 25-hour techno session with Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza and Daria Kolosova among the bill.

events.title: Mathame All Night Long at KOKO
events.summary: Italian melodic techno duo Mathame played an all-night-long KOKO theatre session, promoted by the venue as a rare intimate UK show.

events.title: Jayda G, Bibi Seck, Helena Star at KOKO
events.summary: Jayda G returned to KOKO with Bibi Seck and Helena Star for an Electronic Nights programme focused on dancefloor-led house and electronic music.

events.title: Herrensauna 10 Years at FOLD
events.summary: Berlin collective Herrensauna celebrated 10 years at FOLD with CEM, JASSS, MCMLXXXV, SALOME, Slim Soledad, Twang and ZACKITO on the lineup.

events.title: Giolì & Assia at KOKO
events.summary: Italian duo Giolì & Assia made their KOKO theatre debut with a live/DJ-led sound blending techno, house, indie and pop elements.

events.title: Teletech XXL at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Teletech, The Warehouse Project and Broadwick Live brought a large-scale hard-techno showcase to DRUMSHEDS, with Azyr B2B BLK., Fantasm, Holy Priest, MarcelDune, Novah B2B Hannah Laing and many more.

events.title: anyone can dance: Eastern Margins at the Barbican
events.summary: The Barbican launched its anyone can dance late-night party series with an Eastern Margins-curated night featuring Nick Cheo, KOLLIN, Jianbo and MEYY.

events.title: DJ Marky & Friends at KOKO
events.summary: DJ Marky & Friends took over KOKO for a daytime event celebrating drum & bass, jungle and Marky’s Brazilian-rooted global club sound.

events.title: FAC51 The Haçienda at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: FAC51 The Haçienda staged its biggest indoor show to date at DRUMSHEDS, headlined by Groove Armada, Haçienda Classical, Deep Dish, Roger Sanchez, Inner City and other house-music figures.

events.title: Eastenderz at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Eastenderz returned to London for its biggest showcase yet at DRUMSHEDS, with house and tech-house names led by East End Dubs, Hot Since 82, Kolter, Jamback, Laidlaw and Cristina Lazic.

events.title: Fred again.. USB002 Residency at Alexandra Palace
events.summary: Fred again.. continued his USB002 London residency at Alexandra Palace, with the official label press release listing 12, 13, 26 and 27 February 2026 London dates.

data.notes: March 2026 in London was unusually strong for arena-scale country, jazz and pop benefit concerts, alongside major electronic takeovers at Drumsheds, Roundhouse and fabric.

events.title: C2C: Country to Country 2026
events.summary: Country To Country returned to The O2 for three days, with Zach Top, Keith Urban and Brooks & Dunn listed among the main headliners. The official O2 page also confirmed additional artists including Scotty McCreery, Russell Dickerson, Drake Milligan and Alana Springsteen.

events.title: Teenage Cancer Trust at Royal Albert Hall 2026
events.summary: The 2026 Royal Albert Hall benefit concert series was curated by Robert Smith and featured Elbow, Mogwai, Manic Street Preachers, My Bloody Valentine, Garbage with Placebo, and Wolf Alice across the week. The source lists each nightly bill and date from 23 to 29 March.

events.title: Southbank Centre x Montreux Jazz Festival Residency
events.summary: The Southbank Centre and Montreux Jazz Festival residency returned for a three-day programme themed around “What is Jazz Today?”. Listed highlights included Theo Croker, Children of Zeus, Women in Jazz and corto.alto.

events.title: Trans Mission
events.summary: Trans Mission was billed by OVO Arena Wembley as a one-night solidarity concert, with Adam Lambert, Beth Ditto, Beverley Knight, Christine and the Queens, Olly Alexander, Romy, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Sugababes, Tom Grennan and Wolf Alice among the listed performers. The venue page confirms the 11 March 2026 date.

events.title: Wu-Tang Clan: Wu-Tang Forever - The Final Chamber
events.summary: Wu-Tang Clan brought the Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber tour to The O2 on Tuesday 17 March 2026, with Havoc of Mobb Deep and DJ Target listed as special guests. The O2 page confirms the 17 March date and venue.

events.title: ANTS at Drumsheds
events.summary: Ibiza party brand ANTS staged its biggest London show at Drumsheds, with B2B sets including Andrea Oliva b2b Ilario Alicante, Loco Dice b2b Green Velvet, Nic Fanciulli b2b Prunk and TSHA b2b HoneyLuv. Kaboodle lists the event for 6 March 2026 at Drumsheds.

events.title: Drumcode London at Drumsheds
events.summary: Drumcode returned to Drumsheds for a 30-year showcase featuring Adam Beyer, Bart Skils, Cassian, Chris Avantgarde, Eli Brown, Kasia, Kevin de Vries, Marco Faraone and Victor Ruiz among the listed lineup. The Drumsheds registration page confirms Saturday 7 March.

events.title: Laufey - A Matter of Time Tour
events.summary: Laufey played two O2 arena dates on the A Matter of Time Tour, with Alice Phoebe Lou listed as special guest. The official venue page confirms shows on Sunday 8 and Monday 9 March 2026.

events.title: Continuum: Craig Richards, Call Super, Nicolas Lutz, DJ Nobu, Channel One, Gabrielle Kwarteng
events.summary: fabric’s Continuum programme listed Craig Richards, Call Super, Nicolas Lutz, DJ Nobu, Channel One, Gabrielle Kwarteng, Willow, XDB and more for its 28 March edition. Resident Advisor marks the event as an RA Pick and lists techno and house as genres.

events.title: Labyrinth presents: Oliver Heldens at Roundhouse
events.summary: Labyrinth presented Oliver Heldens at Roundhouse on 6 March 2026, with BL3SS and GAWP listed as support. Resident Advisor confirms the 19:00–23:00 event time and lineup.

events.title: HOLI FEST 2026 London
events.summary: Desi Beatz and BollywoodLDN presented HOLI FEST 2026 at The Cause, billed as an outdoor colour-throwing festival celebrating South Asian music and culture. The RA listing confirms 7 March 2026 at The Cause with a music policy covering Bollywood, Desi anthems, house, dance and club classics.

data.notes: April 2026 in London was especially strong for electronic programming, with fabric, KOKO, Studio 338, Roundhouse and Southbank Centre all carrying notable club, live and festival events.

events.title: London Soundtrack Festival 2026
events.summary: The second London Soundtrack Festival ran across four days celebrating film, TV and games music. David Arnold headlined the 2026 edition, with events hosted at venues including the Barbican, Cadogan Hall and Westminster Central Hall.

events.title: Roundhouse Three Sixty Festival 2026
events.summary: Roundhouse Three Sixty returned with a broad arts-and-music programme including Kae Tempest, Amaarae, Imogen Heap, Carl Craig & Octave One, Femi Koleoso’s Good Vibes Day and Situation Dance. The festival marked the Camden venue’s 20th anniversary since reopening.

events.title: Multitudes 2026
events.summary: Southbank Centre’s orchestral-led Multitudes festival ran from 16–30 April 2026. Its centrepiece was Un-natural Harmony: Sounds of Lee Alexander McQueen, a London Contemporary Orchestra collaboration reworking music tied to McQueen’s runway legacy.

events.title: Olivia Dean: The Art of Loving Live
events.summary: Olivia Dean opened her first headline run at The O2 on 29 April 2026 as part of The Art of Loving Live tour. The O2 listing confirmed further London dates on 30 April, 1–2 May and 11–12 June.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Joseph Capriati
events.summary: Joseph Capriati returned to KOKO for a Friday late-night electronic show with Miguelle & TONS and Vanee. The event was part of KOKO Electronic’s April programme.

events.title: All Day I Dream of London with Lee Burridge
events.summary: All Day I Dream brought its melodic house sound to Studio 338 with Lee Burridge, Satori, Pippi Ciez, Dim Kelly and Raw Main. The event ran from 2pm to 2am at the Greenwich venue.

events.title: fabric: Joris Voorn (All Night Long), ELIF, Ivory, RICHE, Nyra
events.summary: Joris Voorn played an all-night-long Room 1 set at fabric, joined across the venue by ELIF, Ivory, RICHE and Nyra. The Saturday programme ran from 23:00 to 07:00.

events.title: fabric: giegling
events.summary: Giegling took over fabric with live sets from Map.ache, Swayzak, Edward, Tobias. and Leafar Legov, plus DJ sets from Cassy, Konstantin, Eduardo de la Calle and others. The event ran overnight on 18 April.

events.title: FABRICLIVE: Sarz, VIGRO DEEP, Dave Nunes, Nicky Summers, Jordss, TMXO, Aniko + more
events.summary: FABRICLIVE hosted a multi-room programme led by Sarz & Friends, with Sarz, VIGRO DEEP, Dave Nunes and Nicky Summers in Room 1. The night also included PULSE (NL) and Jordss Presents Journeyss rooms.

events.title: Palais: Bradley Zero (All Night Long) - 4 Fridays of Rhythm Section
events.summary: Bradley Zero played an all-night-long Rhythm Section residency date at Palais in Peckham. The listing framed the April run as four Fridays of Rhythm Section, with X & Ivy in the ballroom on the 24 April edition.

events.title: Carl Craig & Octave One Live
events.summary: Detroit techno figures Carl Craig and Octave One performed live as part of Roundhouse Three Sixty, presented with Labyrinth. The event also featured a pre-show screening of Desire: The Carl Craig Story.

events.title: Labyrinth presents: Cassius Live
events.summary: Labyrinth presented Cassius Live at KOKO, with Boombass bringing the French touch project back to London. The event was listed as an early-evening electronic show on Saturday 25 April.

data.notes: May 2026 in London is anchored by the Brockwell Park festival run, Peckham’s GALA weekend, and several arena-scale pop and electronic shows at The O2.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL at The O2
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL headline The O2 with special guest SG Lewis on 13 May 2026. The arena show brings one of electronic music’s biggest live acts to Greenwich.

events.title: Highways Festival 2026
events.summary: Highways Festival returns to Royal Albert Hall from 15–17 May 2026. The country and Americana weekend is headlined by Jon Pardi, Carly Pearce and Emmylou Harris.

events.title: RAYE: This Tour May Contain New Music
events.summary: RAYE closes her major arena run with two May dates at The O2 on 19 and 20 May 2026. ABSOLUTELY and AMMA are listed as special guests.

events.title: GALA ’26
events.summary: GALA returns to Peckham Rye Park for a three-day edition from 22–24 May 2026. The lineup spans South London rap, bass, house and disco, with Giggs, CASisDEAD, Todd Terje, DJ Seinfeld and Seth Troxler among the listed names.

events.title: Black Coffee: Live With Orchestra
events.summary: Black Coffee brings his Live With Orchestra concept to The O2 on 22 May 2026. The show is billed as his biggest UK performance to date and combines his Afropolitan house sound with a full orchestra.

events.title: Field Day 2026
events.summary: Field Day takes over Brockwell Park on 23 May 2026. The electronic-focused bill includes Floating Points live, Honey Dijon, Andy C, Joy Orbison, KI/KI, Eliza Rose and more.

events.title: ZAYN: The Konnakol Tour
events.summary: ZAYN brings The Konnakol Tour to The O2 on 23 May 2026. The show is part of his largest solo tour to date and follows the release of his KONNAKOL album.

events.title: Cross The Tracks 2026
events.summary: Cross The Tracks returns to Brockwell Park on 24 May 2026. The jazz, soul, funk and hip-hop lineup includes Little Simz, Joy Crookes, Kokoroko, KNUCKS, WAR, Obongjayar and Fabio & Grooverider with The Outlook Orchestra.

events.title: City Splash 2026
events.summary: City Splash takes place at Brockwell Park on 25 May 2026. The Caribbean and African culture celebration lists Gyptian, Beres Hammond, Jada Kingdom, Aidonia, Elephant Man, Rampage Sound and many more.

events.title: Doja Cat: Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Tour Ma Vie World Tour to The O2 on 29 May 2026. The show supports her fifth studio album, Vie.

events.title: Mighty Hoopla 2026
events.summary: Mighty Hoopla returns to Brockwell Park across 30–31 May 2026. The pop and queer-culture festival lists Lily Allen, Scissor Sisters, Jessie J, Perrie, Five, JLS and Todrick Hall among its lineup.

events.title: Raindance 2026 at fabric
events.summary: Raindance returns to fabric on 30 May 2026 for a daytime rave across three rooms. The lineup includes DJ Brockie, Nicky Blackmarket, Nookie, Blapps Posse & The Freestylers, Pete Cannon and more.

data.notes: June 2026 is unusually strong in London, with citywide showcases, Southbank curation, arena pop/R&B, outdoor park concerts and a solid underground-club run all confirmed.

events.title: SXSW London 2026 Music Festival
events.summary: SXSW London’s music programme takes over Shoreditch with showcase artists including Earl Sweatshirt, Sega Bodega, Rachel Chinouriri, ODUMODUBLVCK, Tiwa Savage and Shame. The event combines live music, industry programming and cross-cultural showcases across the week.

events.title: Harry Styles’ Meltdown
events.summary: Harry Styles curates the 31st Meltdown festival at Southbank Centre, with confirmed programming including Warpaint, Shabaka & Friends, Erika de Casier, Kamasi Washington, Nilüfer Yanya, Devonté Hynes Ensemble, Yussef Dayes, Jon Hopkins and Soulwax. Styles is also listed for a Royal Festival Hall appearance during the festival.

events.title: BST Hyde Park: Garth Brooks
events.summary: American Express presents BST Hyde Park opens its 2026 run with Garth Brooks headlining, joined by Zac Brown Band and Ashley McBryde. The official BST page lists the show for Saturday 27 June 2026.

events.title: FKA twigs: BODY HIGH TOUR
events.summary: FKA twigs plays a UK-exclusive BODY HIGH TOUR show at The O2 with special guest Yves Tumor. The event is tied to her EUSEXUA Afterglow era and is billed by The O2 for Wednesday 10 June 2026.

events.title: KAYTRANADA with Uncle Waffles
events.summary: KAYTRANADA headlines The O2 with Uncle Waffles as special guest. The O2 lists the show for Thursday 18 June 2026 as part of his upcoming tour.

events.title: Olivia Dean: The Art of Loving Live
events.summary: Olivia Dean brings The Art of Loving Live to The O2 for a London arena run; this entry uses the explicitly listed 11 June 2026 date. The O2 also lists a second June date on 12 June.

events.title: Hampton Court Palace Festival 2026
events.summary: The palace concert series returns with confirmed 2026 headliners including David Gray, OMD, Pete Tong Ibiza Classics, The Stranglers, Nile Rodgers & CHIC, Elvis Costello & The Imposters, Sophie Ellis-Bextor and 80s Classical. It is a near-London heritage-setting music festival with nightly shows in June.

events.title: The Cause ∞ Forever: 8th Birthday - 24hr Non-Stop
events.summary: A 24-hour, eight-floor birthday marathon for The Cause with Sound Metaphors, Fast & Bi-Furious, Fèmmme Fraîche, Persona, Das Booty and more, spanning house and techno with Chez Damier b2b Jovonn, Prosumer, Paranoid London live, Planetary Assault Systems live and many more.

events.title: OUTRO Festival 2026
events.summary: OUTRO Festival returns to The Cause with a bass-forward lineup including Special Request, Tim Reaper, Yung Singh, Sully, Capo Lee, Jossy Mitsu, Y U QT and more. Resident Advisor lists the day-to-night event for Saturday 20 June 2026.

events.title: Empire of the Sun: Ask That God Europe 2026
events.summary: Empire of the Sun play a multi-night Alexandra Palace Great Hall run for the Ask That God tour. Alexandra Palace lists 24–27 June 2026 and notes an extra 24 June date added due to demand.

events.title: Another Thought 2026
events.summary: Small Talk and Another Thought launch a multi-venue Blackhorse Lane day-to-night dance with Erol Alkan, Dennis Bovell, Emma-Jean Thackray, Joe Armon-Jones, Factory Floor live, Crazy P, Tash LC, Bill Brewster, Sound Metaphors DJs and many local selectors.

events.title: New York Philharmonic Concerts in the Parks

events.title: New York Philharmonic Pride Concert

data.notes: February 2026 in Paris combined arena-scale pop and rock dates with Radio France experimental festivals and a strong techno/electronic club thread.

events.title: MIKA

events.title: Clara Luciani

events.title: Florence + The Machine

data.notes: March 2026 in Paris mixed arena-scale pop and hip-hop with a strong run of indie, jazz/world and club-focused festivals across the city and close suburbs.

events.title: Les Inrocks Festival 2026

events.title: L2P Convention 2026

events.summary: La Place’s sixth L2P Convention brought four days of hip-hop and street-culture programming to La Place and partner venues. The format combined concerts, talks, workshops, exhibitions and professional networking around rap, DJing, dance and urban culture.

events.title: 43e Festival Banlieues Bleues
events.venueName: Various venues in Seine-Saint-Denis and Paris area

The festival focused on adventurous jazz, global sounds and hybrid music, with March events including Uzi Freyja + Twende Pamoja, AMG + 15 15, Orchestre de la Crèche and TERRINE + FRANTX + Rojin Sharafi.

events.summary: The 22nd International Choro Festival of Paris took place at Maison du Brésil from March 27 to 29 under the artistic direction of Maria Inês Guimarães. The program centered on concerts and workshops celebrating Brazilian choro music.

events.title: Indochine — Arena Tour at Accor Arena

events.title: Thundercat at Salle Pleyel
events.summary: Thundercat stopped at Salle Pleyel on Wednesday, March 18, with Andy 4000 listed as support. The show highlighted his jazz, funk, soul and R&B fusion in a seated-and-standing concert configuration.

events.title: LEGENDS: Louie Vega, Joe Claussell, DJ Deep
events.summary: Rex Club hosted a heavyweight house night on March 15 with Louie Vega, Joe Claussell and DJ Deep. The bill brought New York house lineage and Parisian deep-house heritage into one late-night club session.

events.title: Rex Club presents: Sama' Abdulhadi

events.title: Supersonic’s Block Party Festival 2026

events.title: TWICE <THIS IS FOR> World Tour in Paris
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE plays two Accor Arena dates on the Paris stop of the <THIS IS FOR> World Tour.

events.title: Cercle Festival 2026

events.summary: Cercle Festival returns to Le Bourget for three days with a large international electronic lineup including Eric Prydz, ARTBAT, Adriatique, Kerri Chandler, Kölsch and Ben Böhmer.

events.title: Marvellous Island Festival 2026

events.title: David Guetta — The Ultimate Monolith Show

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour 2026

events.title: Iron Maiden — Run For Your Lives Tour

events.title: KAYTRANADA

events.title: Soft Power Festival

events.summary: RA reports Soft Power’s first edition running 9–14 June across Paris venues, with Dana Montana & Babu as Girls @ Work, KALIKA live, Tina Tornade, TRASHIE, Harey izé, MASCHA, Maria Kalash and Diane. The programme combines cabaret, DJ performances, discussions and workshops from the Kluster collective.

events.title: Rex Club presents: Octave One Live, STL-P, WhereIsFenix
events.summary: Resident Advisor lists this Rex Club techno night for Friday 5 June with Octave One Live, STL-P and WhereIsFenix. Rex Club is the promoter on the listing.

data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stadium-heavy in Paris, with major Latin, pop, K-pop, rock and electronic festival dates clustered in the first three weekends.

events.title: The Weeknd 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: The Weeknd is confirmed for four Stade de France concerts on July 8, 10, 11 and 12, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office lists the July 8 date as the fourth and final added show.

events.title: BTS 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: BTS are confirmed for two Stade de France concerts on July 17 and 18, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office bills them as two special dates for the K-pop group’s return.

events.title: Bad Bunny – DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour
events.summary: Bad Bunny is confirmed for July 4 and 5, 2026 at Paris La Défense Arena, billed as his first performance in France. CHUWI is listed as the opening act.

events.title: System Of A Down with Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath
events.summary: System Of A Down are confirmed at Stade de France on July 2 and July 4, 2026. The Stade de France listing names Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath as special guests.

events.title: Peacock Society 2026
events.summary: Peacock Society is confirmed as an open-air electronic festival on July 10–11, 2026 at Hippodrome Paris-Vincennes. The official lineup page lists artists including Four Tet, Floating Points, Boys Noize b2b SALOME, Channel Tres b2b Busy P, Benga & Flowdan, Palms Trax and Mia Koden.

events.title: Guns N’ Roses – World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N’ Roses are confirmed for two Accor Arena shows on July 1 and July 3, 2026. Mammoth is listed as opening act on the venue page.

events.title: Yardland 2026
events.summary: Yardland is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026, with a day-by-day urban music lineup including Niska, Jorja Smith, Skepta and Rema. The festival focuses on rap, R&B, Afro and dancehall-adjacent contemporary popular culture.

events.title: Romeo Santos & Prince Royce – Mejor Tarde Que Nunca Tour
events.summary: Romeo Santos and Prince Royce are confirmed for a joint Accor Arena concert on July 19, 2026. The venue describes it as their first time joining forces in Europe on the Mejor Tarde Que Nunca tour.

events.title: Rhadoo - all night long
events.summary: Romanian minimal figure Rhadoo plays all night long at essaim, a strong pick for travelers following micro-house, minimal and deep techno circuits.

events.title: Def Leppard with special guest Extreme
events.summary: Def Leppard are confirmed at Accor Arena on July 8, 2026, with Extreme as special guest. The venue frames it as Def Leppard’s first Paris show in nearly 30 years.

events.title: BELLE EPOQUE! x HORDE OPEN AIR
events.summary: A 14-hour open-air-to-late-night house session from Belle Epoque, Horde Paris, Fvtvr and Wanderlust, with Jan Blomqvist, Rodriguez Jr., Viken Arman and a broad local support slate.

events.title: la Culottée (Nord + Sud)
events.summary: A heavily watched La Station night split across Nord and Sud rooms with Amina, audio primitive, Rachel Noon, Gay Haze, Fais Le Beau and more.

events.title: Pornceptual: COCKO, Kandelissa, LOLSNAKE, Spacer Woman
events.summary: Berlin-born Pornceptual brings its club-culture, art, fashion and radical self-expression concept to Virage for a Berlin x Paris techno lineup with a mandatory dress code.

events.title: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival
events.summary: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival is confirmed for July 11 and 12, 2026 at Arena Grand Paris, celebrating 20 years of Japanese activities. The organizer-side lineup includes Versailles, MUCC, LM.C and Kizu on July 11, with Moi Dix Mois, D’espairsRay, An Cafe, Jiluka, Azavana and Imperial Age on July 12.

events.title: Dance And Go Home X SBB Paris
events.summary: Touring culture platform Dance and Go Home links with SBB Paris for a diaspora day-to-night party blending Afrobeats, Amapiano, hip-hop, R&B and dancehall.

events.title: tribalism - Freddy K, Hemka
events.summary: A serious techno night at essaim led by Freddy K and Hemka, with the club’s limited-presale/door-ticket format built for heads rather than casual traffic.

events.title: La Clairière: MoBlack, Agoria, CLARAA
events.summary: Afro-house pioneer MoBlack headlines La Clairière alongside Agoria and CLARAA for a deep, travel-ready electronic night in the Bois de Boulogne setting.

events.title: cocoon - Eris Drew, Yaël Ohayon
events.summary: Eris Drew joins Yaël Ohayon at essaim for a high-quality, queer-adjacent electronic night that should appeal to house and techno travelers looking beyond festival programming.

events.title: Vulfpeck 2026
events.summary: Vulfpeck are confirmed for a single Accor Arena show on July 9, 2026. The venue bills the Los Angeles group’s Paris return as a funk-heavy arena date.

events.title: Paris New York Heritage Festival 2026
events.summary: Paris New York Heritage Festival is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026 at Parc André Citroën. The official site describes the event as an EcoVillage built around jazz, soul and funk, with concerts and DJ sets; the full artist program is still marked as forthcoming.

data.notes: September 2026 in Paris is already anchored by major arena pop/hip-hop dates, a Céline Dion arena residency, and strong electronic-festival programming around Chatou/La Villette.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2026
events.summary: Céline Dion opens her Paris La Défense Arena residency on Saturday 12 September 2026, with the venue FAQ listing further September and October dates. This is a representative confirmed September date for the residency.

events.title: Madame Loyal X Elektric Park
events.summary: Madame Loyal and Elektric Park join forces for a two-day open-air rave/funfair event in Chatou, about 20 minutes from Paris. The confirmed lineup includes Bob Sinclar, Kavinsky, Hannah Laing, Skream & Benga, Petit Biscuit, Ascendant Vierge and more.

events.title: Global Black Pride Music Festival 2026
events.summary: Global Black Pride lists its Music Festival in Paris for 12–13 September 2026, billed as The Global Black Queer Fest. The event page highlights live music, iconic performances, day and after-parties, and sounds including house and amapiano.

events.title: A$AP Rocky — Don’t Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky brings the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour to Accor Arena for a Paris arena date. The venue page confirms the concert for 30 September 2026.

events.title: Sonora X Impact
events.summary: SONORA and Impact join forces for a two-night XXL hard-techno warehouse-format event with Anetha, Trym, Clara Cuvé, Pegassi, Øtta, Somewhen, and more.

events.title: The Pussycat Dolls — PCD Forever Tour
events.summary: The Pussycat Dolls return to Accor Arena with Lil’ Kim on the PCD Forever Tour. The venue confirms the Paris concert for 19 September 2026.

events.title: Joji — SOLARIS TOUR
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS TOUR to adidas arena for a France-exclusive Paris date, with Tommy Richman listed for the European dates. The venue page confirms a 1 September 2026 concert.

events.title: Melanie Martinez — HADES: THE SACRIFICE
events.summary: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE tour to Accor Arena in support of her fourth studio album, HADES. The Accor Arena page confirms the concert for 15 September 2026.

events.title: Nightclubbing Festival
events.venueName: La Villette and multiple Paris venues
events.summary: Jen Cardini and AEG Presents France launch Nightclubbing Festival from 24–27 September 2026, based at La Villette and spread across Paris clubs and cultural venues. The concept celebrates electronic music, nightlife culture, and the collective energy of the dancefloor.

events.title: The Neighbourhood
events.summary: The Neighbourhood play Accor Arena on their world tour, with Noise Dept. and Nessa Barrett listed as openers. The venue page confirms the 8 September 2026 date.

events.title: Paris Black Pride | Global Edition
events.summary: Afro Boyz Club’s Black Pride special, billed as an XXL Afro Boyz Party with Dancehall, Hip Hop, Afrobeat, and R&B energy.

events.title: Jazz à la Villette: Selah Sue and The Gallands
events.summary: Part of Jazz à la Villette, this 4 September concert presents Selah Sue with The Gallands at Grande Halle de La Villette. The Philharmonie page lists the festival dates and confirms the performance time at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Raw Warehouse
events.summary: RAW returns after summer with a secret-warehouse techno edition, Funktion-One sound, and a strong Paris underground following.

events.title: Loreen — The Wildfire Tour
events.summary: Loreen plays Salle Pleyel on The Wildfire Tour, with the venue listing a 30 September 2026 concert at 20:00. The show supports her 2026 Wildfire album era.

events.title: La Clairière: CamelPhat, Calao
events.summary: Open-air Bois de Boulogne club session with CamelPhat and Calao, aimed at the melodic house and techno crowd.

events.title: Chamos - Petit Bain
events.summary: A Petit Bain night listed with Club, Arabic House, and Bass tags, bringing diaspora-club electronics into a Seine-side venue.

events.title: Carbonne
events.summary: French rap/hip-hop artist Carbonne plays L’Olympia after a prior run including sold-out La Cigale shows. The Olympia page confirms the concert for Saturday 12 September 2026 at 20:00.

events.title: Jacques Fromage Jungle Barbecue - 2 Jours Chez Jacques
events.summary: A two-day forest-side electro/house/techno gathering near Paris, framed as Jacques Fromage’s annual ‘electro-fromage’ Jungle Barbecue.

events.title: J'peux Pas, J'ai Péniche... Closing Été 2026 !
events.summary: A summer-closing Seine boat party with cruise, terrace, food, DJ sets, sax improvisation, and a broad pop/house/R&B singalong brief.

events.title: Essosa
events.summary: East London R&B artist Essosa plays La Boule Noire after building momentum through viral R&B tracks and international support slots.

data.notes: October balances industry showcases, electronic Halloween week, diaspora/world-music programming and arena-scale pop, rap and Afrobeats concerts.

events.title: Dream Nation Festival 2026 — Halloween Edition
events.venueName: Parc des Expositions Paris Nord Villepinte
events.summary: Dream Nation’s 13th edition brings two Halloween nights of electronic music to Paris Nord Villepinte, with NOVAH, Vini Vici, Pendulum DJ set, Netsky, Angerfist live, Da Tweekaz, Infected Mushroom and many more on the bill.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2026
events.summary: Céline Dion’s Paris 2026 limited engagement reaches its October run at Paris La Défense Arena; the 17 October performance is a confirmed representative date from the residency schedule.

events.title: MaMA Music & Convention 2026
events.summary: The 17th edition of MaMA returns to Pigalle and Montmartre for three days of music-industry convention programming and emerging-artist showcases across multiple venues.

events.title: Chevry Agency: 8th Anniversary [XXL Format · 4 Stages]
events.summary: A 22-hour, four-stage anniversary by Chevry Agency across FVTVR and Wanderlust, billed with 34+ international guests and 4,000 people expected.

events.title: Paris Electronic Week 26
events.venueName: Mains d’Œuvres / La Station - Gare des Mines / Petit Bain / Point Éphémère / TLM
events.summary: Technopol’s electronic-music convention and festival runs across Paris-area venues with conferences, workshops and live/club programming including Femme Bass Mafia, La Station live sets and Mains d’Œuvres showcases.

events.title: Festival Jazz sur Seine 2026
events.venueName: Multiple Paris and Île-de-France jazz clubs
events.summary: Paris Jazz Club’s anniversary edition spans 30 venues with 200 concerts and 450+ artists, foregrounding the city’s year-round club jazz ecosystem across jazz, blues, soul and fusion.

events.title: Asake: In God We Trust World Tour
events.summary: Nigerian Afrobeats star Asake plays Accor Arena on his In God We Trust World Tour, with BNXN and TxC listed as support.

events.title: 2026 LE SSERAFIM Tour ‘Pureflow’ in Paris
events.summary: LE SSERAFIM play their first France concert at Accor Arena as part of the 2026 ‘Pureflow’ tour.

events.title: The Strokes
events.summary: The Strokes bring an arena-scale Paris date to Accor Arena, with the venue billing the show around new album material plus the band’s catalogue classics.

events.title: TEMET x Fata Morgana
events.summary: RA Pick experimental-club takeover at La Station with Amnesia Scanner DJ set, k means b2b Simo Cell, Rosa Pistola, Rodrigue Dubois live and Fata Morgana all-stars.

events.title: AMAPIANOLAND - Amapiano & Afrobeats Halloween Day Party
events.summary: WhatsTheMotiveUK brings the touring AmapianoLand brand to Greater Paris for a 2,000-person day party centered on amapiano, afrobeats, kwaito and Afro-house culture.

events.title: Villes des Musiques du Monde 2026
events.summary: The world/diaspora music festival’s October programme includes Paris and near-Paris dates with Imarhan, Sulaf, Temenik Electric, Tiwiza, Séksion Maloya, Alune Wade and other cross-cultural projects.

events.title: ARTE Concert Festival 2026
events.summary: ARTE Concert Festival returns to La Gaîté Lyrique for two free evenings of live performances and encounters, with reported 2026 names including Shygirl and Kneecap.

events.title: Le Grand Bal — Youssou Ndour & Le Super Étoile de Dakar
events.summary: Youssou Ndour and Le Super Étoile de Dakar bring the mythic Grand Bal back to Accor Arena with guests and surprises announced for the Paris show.

events.title: Free Your Funk présente Theo Parrish All Night Long
events.summary: Detroit house figure Theo Parrish returns to Paris for a rare vinyl-only all-night set for Free Your Funk, with Matt Ma Moustache and Wolff also listed upstairs.

events.title: Spectrum Waves: Pride edition
events.summary: Large queer house/techno night by Spectrum Waves at DOCK B with two rooms, a no-photo/no-video policy and a sold-out advance allocation; RA listed 1.9K interested.

events.title: Djs for FLIRT
events.summary: RA Pick La Station night bringing together Oklou, DJ Assou, Bamao b2b Fetva, Urtrax b2b Lux18 and more for leftfield pop, bass, techno and hazy club textures.

events.title: Deepsea Grooves: Chez Damier, Mézigue, Vitaline & More
events.summary: Deepsea Grooves’ first Kilomètre25 takeover and final open-air house date of the season, led by Chicago/Detroit house figure Chez Damier with Mézigue, Vitaline, STO, Bakaer and R1D1.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: British trio Jungle play Accor Arena on October 30, 2026, billed by the venue as their biggest French show to date. The date supports their 2026 album Sunshine.

events.title: Bigflo & Oli
events.summary: French rap duo Bigflo & Oli bring their Karma tour to Accor Arena for two confirmed nights on October 19 and 20, 2026. The venue lists both concerts at 20:00.

events.title: Grünt Festival 5
events.summary: Grünt’s hip-hop and rap festival returns to Grande Halle de la Villette with a scene-heavy lineup including Limsa D’Aulnay, Isha, BU$HI, Asfar Shamsi, REALO, DEELEE S and BEN plg.

events.title: Autechre
events.summary: Autechre perform at Le Bataclan on October 14, 2026. The Bataclan listing frames the date as part of Sean Booth and Rob Brown’s European shows in September and October 2026.

events.title: Gradur
events.summary: French trap artist Gradur plays his first Accor Arena show on October 16, 2026. The venue bills it as a landmark night in French rap history.

events.title: Meryl
events.summary: Meryl is confirmed for two Accor Arena concerts on October 26 and 27, 2026. The venue describes the run as her first show at the arena and highlights her cross-style vocal approach.

events.title: Mosimann Live
events.summary: Mosimann brings his live electronic show to Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 17 and 18, 2026. The venue positions the show as a stage-designed live performance tied to his 2026 creative cycle.

events.title: Alizée
events.summary: Alizée plays Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 4, 2026, as part of her 25th-anniversary return to the stage. The official venue page confirms the single Paris date.

events.title: Lake Street Dive
events.summary: Lake Street Dive perform at Le Bataclan on October 16, 2026. The venue describes the show around their album Good Together, mixing soul, pop, groove and jazz influences.

events.title: Bellaire — La Cigale
events.summary: French producer Bellaire brings a warm, dancefloor-focused live show to La Cigale, explicitly billed around house, electro, disco-house, jazz, funk and hip-hop influences.

events.title: Deejay MK — Afro-Caribbean Live Show
events.summary: A diaspora-focused DJ show from Ivorian/Paris-region selector Deejay MK, billed around afrobeats, dancehall, shatta, bouyon, soca, amapiano and urban club sounds at Cabaret Sauvage.

events.title: Fakear — L’Olympia
events.summary: Fakear’s new live show is described by L’Olympia as a raw, club-leaning electronic set rooted in the international bass-music resurgence.

events.title: Spectrum Waves (Nord + Sud)
events.summary: Spectrum Waves returns to La Station for a queer techno-and-house night across the Nord/Sud spaces, with a no-photo policy, awareness team, and community-first safer-space framing.

data.notes: February 2027 is already strong for Paris arena and theatre touring—especially electronic, jazz/R&B and pop—while many underground club calendars are not yet published this far out.

events.title: Charli xcx – Music, Fashion, Film Tour
