events.summary: Charli xcx brings the Music, Fashion, Film Tour to Accor Arena, with Live Nation listing Audrey Hobert as support.

events.title: Chase & Status
events.summary: Chase & Status close the month at Zénith Paris - La Villette, bringing their UK drum & bass and electronic live concept SECTION 63 to Paris.

events.title: John Summit
events.summary: John Summit plays Zénith Paris - La Villette, with the venue framing him as a major global electronic figure behind the Experts Only label and movement.

events.title: 2026-27 aespa LIVE TOUR–SYNK:Complæxity
events.summary: K-pop group aespa brings its global SYNK:Complæxity tour to Accor Arena, with the venue billing it as part of an arena tour across Asia, the Americas, the UK and Europe.

events.title: Masego – Fix Your Face Tour
events.summary: Masego plays Salle Pleyel on the Fix Your Face Tour, with the venue describing a live show shaped by jazz, R&B, hip-hop and his multi-instrumentalist approach.

events.title: Ezra Collective
events.summary: Mercury Prize- and BRIT Award-winning UK band Ezra Collective comes to Zénith Paris - La Villette, with JOY Anonymous listed as support.

events.title: Emeli Sandé – Our Version of Events 15th Anniversary
events.summary: Emeli Sandé performs at Salle Pleyel on a 15th-anniversary tour for Our Version of Events, billed as her only France stop on the tour.

events.title: Phantom X Galop Galop: Bassjackers, Part Time Killer
events.summary: Large-format Phantom x Galop Galop club night pairing Bassjackers with Part Time Killer and a trance/techno lineup, listed with strong interest on Shotgun.

events.title: Lewis OfMan
events.summary: Lewis OfMan moves into La Machine du Moulin Rouge for a concert/club-format Paris date built around electro-pop, disco grooves and synth textures.

events.title: Electric Callboy
events.summary: Electric Callboy brings the TANZNEID World Tour 2027 to Accor Arena, with the venue highlighting the band’s mix of heavy riffs, electronic beats and high-energy staging.

events.title: EVNNE “ONE TAKE” Tour
events.summary: K-pop group EVNNE brings its ONE TAKE fan-concert tour to Le Bataclan, with Paris listed among the tour’s international stops.

events.title: Mon Amour - Valentine’s Night
events.summary: Valentine’s edition from Mon Amour, a recurring Paris house/electro promoter brand with Afro-house and tech-house programming and a sizable Shotgun following.

events.title: Erik Truffaz & Antonio Lizana
events.summary: Electro-jazz trumpeter Erik Truffaz joins saxophonist/vocalist Antonio Lizana for a Salle Pleyel concert inspired by jazz, flamenco and Spanish musical traditions.

events.title: Pasión de Buena Vista
events.summary: Pasión de Buena Vista brings a Cuban music-and-dance production to Salle Pleyel, centered on rumba, mambo, cha-cha-cha, salsa and classic Cuban repertoire.

events.title: Sam Quealy
events.summary: Paris-based performer Sam Quealy presents her album JAWBREAKER at L’Olympia, with the venue describing a dance-pop, disco and electro show shaped by club culture.

events.title: Young Chang MC
events.summary: Guadeloupean artist Young Chang MC plays L’Olympia with a set rooted in Caribbean dancehall, rap and Antillean sounds.

events.title: Generation 90 Vs 2000 (Sam 06 Fév)
events.summary: Recurring 90s/2000s boat-party brand on the Seine, mixing pop, house and hip-hop across two floors and a covered terrace, with the listing advertising 800+ partygoers.

events.title: Dominguinho
events.summary: João Gomes, Mestrinho and Jota.Pê present Dominguinho at Salle Pleyel, bringing a Brazilian music project centered on warmth, songcraft and live performance.

data.notes: March 2027 is already anchored by Banlieues Bleues plus a strong run of arena pop, Francophone rap, diaspora pop, jazz, and electronic/live-club dates.

events.title: Angèle — Instinct Tour
events.summary: Angèle plays a multi-night Accor Arena run on 8, 9, 10, 12 and 13 March 2027 as part of her Instinct Tour. The venue page describes the Belgian artist as a major voice in contemporary European pop.

events.title: Banlieues Bleues 44th Edition
events.summary: Banlieues Bleues confirms its 44th edition from 5 March to 2 April 2027, bringing its long-running jazz and adventurous-music festival format to venues around Greater Paris.

events.title: Teddy Swims
events.summary: Teddy Swims plays Accor Arena on 30 and 31 March 2027. The venue describes him as a powerful soul voice crossing R&B, pop and country.

events.title: Magic System — 30th Anniversary
events.summary: Magic System celebrate 30 years of their career at Accor Arena on 21 March 2027. The venue frames it as an anniversary event built around global hits including “Premier Gaou” and “Magic in the Air.”

events.title: ElGrandeToto — Salgoat World Tour
events.summary: Moroccan-Francophone rap star ElGrandeToto brings the Salgoat World Tour to Accor Arena on 27 March 2027. The venue notes his move from sold-out Olympia and Zénith shows into arena scale.

events.title: KeBlack
events.summary: KeBlack plays Accor Arena on 25 March 2027. The venue positions the concert as a celebration of his recent hit streak and rise through the French urban-pop scene.

events.title: Grand Corps Malade
events.summary: Grand Corps Malade performs two adidas arena dates on 12 and 13 March 2027. The venue confirms the French slam and rap figure’s return to the stage with a new tour.

events.title: Tash Sultana
events.summary: Tash Sultana’s adidas arena concert is confirmed for 29 March 2027 after being rescheduled from 13 March 2026. The venue says existing tickets remain valid for the new Paris date.

events.title: Chloé - L’Olympia
events.summary: A rare headline concert from Chloé, the Paris electronic DJ/producer closely associated with Pulp-era club culture and left-field, emotionally driven DJ sets.

events.title: Yuston XIII
events.summary: Yuston XIII plays Accor Arena on 20 March 2027, following the release of Les Enfants du Chaos. The arena presents the date as a major return for the French artist.

events.title: Moses Boyd
events.summary: Moses Boyd performs at La Bellevilloise on 25 March 2027. The venue presents the Mercury Prize-nominated drummer, producer and composer around his album Songs For Sinners, spanning jazz, gospel, sound-system culture and bass music.

events.title: Assassin
events.summary: French hip-hop group Assassin return to Paris at La Cigale on 13 March 2027. The venue bills the group as a foundational conscious rap act led by Rockin’ Squat.

events.title: Sacré Présente: MPH & Friends
events.summary: UK garage producer MPH brings a late-night Sacré session focused on bass-heavy club tracks, framed as a Paris stop after sold-out tours and international festival appearances.

events.title: La Roux
events.summary: La Roux plays Le Trianon on 9 March 2027. The show spotlights the synth-pop artist whose work has been sampled or referenced by artists across pop, club and hip-hop scenes.

events.title: ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U (Yousuke Yukimatsu) @ CENTQUATRE-PARIS
events.summary: Super! presents the boundary-pushing Japanese selector Yousuke Yukimatsu for a confirmed Centquatre appearance, listed on Shotgun under gabber, trance, house and experimental-adjacent tags.

events.title: ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U
events.summary: Japanese selector ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U plays 104 CENTQUATRE on 13 March 2027. Resident Advisor lists the event with Super! as promoter and ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U as the lineup.

events.title: Squeeze
events.summary: British pop institution Squeeze play Le Bataclan on 18 March 2027. The venue highlights the band’s blend of new wave, power pop and melodic songwriting.

events.title: General Elektriks
events.summary: General Elektriks plays La Cigale on 30 March 2027 with a live-band show rooted in funk, soul, hip-hop and jazz. The venue notes the performance will feature material from a new album announced for January 2027.

data.notes: May 2027 is already anchored by major arena pop/rap dates and Marvellous Island’s confirmed open-air electronic weekender, while most smaller Paris club calendars are not yet published.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2027
events.summary: Céline Dion’s Paris residency adds ten confirmed May 2027 shows at Plenitude Arena: 8, 12, 14, 15, 19, 21, 22, 26, 28 and 29 May. The official announcement describes the run as a French-and-English hits concert experience produced by Concerts West, AEG Presents and Inter Concerts.

events.title: Marvellous Island 2027
events.summary: Marvellous Island’s 15th edition is confirmed for 15–16 May 2027 at Plage de Torcy, about 20 minutes from Paris. The open-air electronic festival lists 80 artists across four stages, with the detailed lineup still to come.

events.title: SDM
events.summary: French rapper SDM is confirmed for two Stade de France shows on 29 and 30 May 2027. The stadium’s official page describes the dates as two exceptional shows following his sold-out Zénith and Accor Arena runs.

events.title: Jorja Smith
events.summary: Jorja Smith headlines Accor Arena on 27 May 2027. The venue notes her R&B profile and the newer 2-step, UK garage, house and afro-house direction of What Are The Odds.

events.title: La Mano 1.9
events.summary: Paris 19th-arrondissement rapper La Mano 1.9 headlines Accor Arena on 7 May 2027. The venue announcement highlights his rise through French rap and tracks including “Im Sorry,” “Sexy Woman” and “Parisienne.”

events.title: Odezenne — Programme B
events.summary: Eight-date La Maroquinerie run from French alternative hip-hop/electronic group Odezenne, with May dates on 12, 15, 19, 22, 26 and 29 May before continuing into June.

events.title: Jain - Soul System Tour
events.summary: Four-night Le Trianon run for Jain’s Soul System era, a compact pop-club residency blending electro, funk, rock and dancefloor influences in a 1,000-capacity room.

events.title: SOMBR
events.summary: SOMBR is confirmed at Accor Arena on 22 May 2027. The arena frames the show around his blend of arena pop, indie melancholy and glam charisma.

events.title: MEUTE
events.summary: German techno marching band MEUTE performs at Zénith Paris - La Villette on 15 May 2027. The venue bills the show as an electro concert supporting the group’s album KOSMOS.

events.title: Paris Guitar Festival 2027
events.summary: The 15th edition of Paris Guitar Festival is confirmed for 5–9 May 2027 in Montrouge, just south of Paris. The announced 2027 concerts include CharlÉlie Couture, Sanseverino & Lise Cabaret, Antoine Boyer, Cédric Caillaud & Gilles Réa, Yarol Poupaud and Steve Waring.

events.title: Suzane
events.summary: French pop artist Suzane plays a special Accor Arena concert on 29 May 2027. The venue announcement cites her album Millenium and songs including “Je t’accuse,” “Virile” and “Champagne.”

events.title: Generation 90 vs 2000 (Sam 08 Mai)
events.summary: Monthly Noctambuzz nostalgia club night on a Seine boat, advertised as a two-floor/terrace party for 800+ people with pop, house, hip-hop, R&B and 90s/2000s dancefloor selections.

events.title: Kpop Night
events.venueName: Le Dôme de Paris - Palais des Sports
events.summary: A ticketed K-pop fan-night/live experience built around Korean pop hits, choreography and high-energy crowd participation, positioned as a dedicated genre gathering rather than a single headliner show.

events.title: Groundation - A Tribute To Bob Marley
events.summary: Roots-reggae and experimental-jazz band Groundation brings its rare Bob Marley tribute format to Cabaret Sauvage, a strong diaspora-adjacent live date for Paris’s reggae/jazz crossover crowd.

events.title: Stanislas à La Cigale
events.summary: Structure-presented date for Stanislas, a young Colombes artist positioned between indie rap and alternative pop, following early traction on the French rap-pop scene.

data.notes: June 2027 is still early-announcement territory: confirmed events are led by major festivals and arena concerts, while Paris club and underground calendars are not yet published this far out.

events.title: We Love Green 2027
events.summary: Paris’s flagship eco-minded contemporary music festival returns to Bois de Vincennes for three days. The 2027 dates are confirmed, while the lineup is still to be announced.

events.title: Tame Impala
events.summary: Tame Impala plays two Accor Arena shows with an in-the-round stage setup. Wet Leg is confirmed as support.

events.title: Fun Radio Ibiza Experience 2027
events.summary: Fun Radio Ibiza Experience returns to Accor Arena for its 11th edition. The venue describes it as an arena-scale electronic music show featuring major DJs.

events.title: Tayc — JOŸA Tour
events.summary: Tayc plays three nights at Accor Arena on the JOŸA Tour. The venue bills him as a leading figure in French R&B and the Afrolove movement.

events.title: Don Omar — The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Reggaeton pioneer Don Omar returns to France with The Last King World Tour. Accor Arena confirms the Paris show for June 25, 2027.

events.title: blink-182
events.summary: blink-182 performs a one-off Paris-area arena show in Nanterre, produced by Live Nation. The official venue page confirms the June 15 date at Plenitude Arena.

events.title: Hayley Williams
events.summary: Hayley Williams brings The Hayley Williams Show to Zénith Paris - La Villette for a single Paris date. The venue notes it is her return after appearing at We Love Green the previous year.

events.title: Pépélé Festival
events.summary: Afrobeats and Amapiano-focused summer festival/night with international DJ Skyla Tylaa, positioned as a diaspora dance-music event for Fête de la Musique weekend energy.

events.title: Médine — Enfants du destin
events.summary: French rapper Médine brings an acoustic concert version of Enfants du destin to Salle Pleyel. The show revisits one of the major narrative song cycles from his catalogue.

events.title: Meiway & Le Zo-Gang
events.summary: Ivorian star Meiway brings Le Zo-Gang to Zénith Paris - La Villette for a one-night Paris show. The venue frames it as a career-spanning celebration of his Zoblazo catalogue.

events.title: Yanns — Phénoménal Re-Tour
events.summary: Yanns plays Dôme de Paris on the Phénoménal Re-Tour. The venue highlights a new staging and a high-energy show built around his pop-urban hits.

events.title: Joe Hisaishi symphonique
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: The Philharmonie ticketing page confirms two performances of Joe Hisaishi symphonique on June 9 and 10, 2027. This is a major orchestral draw for film-music and symphonic audiences in Paris.

events.title: Souffle de vie — Ensemble intercontemporain / ManiFeste-2027
events.venueName: Salle des concerts - Cité de la musique
events.summary: Ensemble intercontemporain performs Souffle de vie as part of ManiFeste-2027, Ircam’s contemporary-music festival. The programme includes works by Tristan Murail, Philippe Leroux, Luigi Nono and Sarah Nemtsov with live electronics.

events.title: Gypsy Maestros — Des Balkans au Danube
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: Gypsy Maestros opens the Philharmonie’s Les Balkans focus with musicians from Bucharest and Budapest, including Mónika Lakatos and Roby Lakatos. The concert is confirmed for June 23, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Maki Namekawa — Autour de Joe Hisaishi
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: Pianist Maki Namekawa performs a film- and contemporary-music programme around Joe Hisaishi, Philip Glass, Ryuichi Sakamoto and Toru Takemitsu. The Philharmonie listing confirms the concert for June 7, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: De la tambura à la guitare manouche — Bako Jovanović / Sébastien Giniaux
events.summary: Serbian tambura virtuoso Bako Jovanović meets French guitarist Sébastien Giniaux for a Balkan and manouche-rooted concert. The Philharmonie listing confirms the date as June 25, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Bal Balkans
events.summary: A free participatory Balkan dance event spotlighting music from Bulgaria, Turkey, North Macedonia, Bosnia, Greece and beyond, led by professional and amateur musicians.

data.notes: As of October 2026, September 2027 confirmations are mostly venue-promoted concerts; Paris club nights and late-summer festivals are not yet substantially announced.

events.title: Jok'Air
events.summary: Paris rapper Jok'Air headlines Plenitude Arena for the biggest concert of his career, following the album Pretty Girls Love Jok'Air and a major 2025 sold-out run.

events.title: Trinix
events.summary: French electronic duo Trinix plays two Olympia nights billed as their only French indoor dates of 2027, presenting a new live show after several years of international touring.

events.title: Agnes Obel
events.summary: Agnes Obel plays two Olympia dates around her album The Meaning of Flowers, bringing her chamber-pop sound with elements of alternative pop, jazz and electronic music.

events.title: Mari Froes
events.summary: Brazilian artist Mari Froes brings her international tour to Zénith Paris, with a set drawing on Brazilian popular music, new-album material, and earlier songs.

events.title: Ronan Keating - Just Getting Started World Tour
events.summary: Ronan Keating brings his Just Getting Started World Tour to Salle Pleyel, mixing solo material with Boyzone-era pop hits.

events.title: Zazie - Volatil Tour
events.summary: Zazie returns to the Paris stage at Zénith Paris - La Villette as part of her 2027 Volatil Tour.

events.title: Orange Blossom
events.summary: Orange Blossom closes the Spells from the Drunken Sirens tour at Le Trianon, blending electronic production with Turkish, Egyptian, Malian, Senegalese and Cuban influences.

events.title: Ycare - Resilience Tour
events.summary: Ycare opens a four-date Olympia residency with the Resilience Tour, centered on a rock-influenced Jacques Brel tribute project arranged with Pascal Obispo.

events.title: Marie Sarah
events.summary: Marie Sarah plays Le Trianon after sold-out 2026 full-band dates and support slots for artists including Zucchero and Nile Rodgers/Chic.

events.title: I Gotta Feeling – Saison 3
events.venueName: Le Dôme de Paris - Palais des Sports
events.summary: I Gotta Feeling – Saison 3 is confirmed for two 20:00 performances at Le Dôme de Paris on 24 and 25 September 2027, presented as a three-hour 2000s nostalgia concert show with era-defining hits.

data.notes: January 2026 was heavy on pre-Carnival soca, calypso and steelpan programming around Port of Spain, with major fetes clustering on the final weekend of the month.

events.title: French Toast "The Breakfast & Bacchanal Fete"
events.summary: House of Siete billed French Toast as the official breakfast fete to start Trinidad Carnival 2026. The event was confirmed for Queen Hall, St Ann on Sunday, January 4, 2026.

events.title: Mical Teja | MAS The Experience '26
events.summary: Mical Teja presented MAS The Experience as a Carnival culture-and-music event at Queen's Hall Gardens. The ticket page listed it for January 11–12, 2026 from 5:00 PM to midnight.

events.title: NEON - The Lit Fete
events.summary: WinerBoy Entertainment's NEON - The Lit Fete was listed as a music and Carnival event at Queen's Park Oval. TicketGateway confirmed the date as January 16–17, 2026, 9:00 PM–3:00 AM.

events.title: Phoenix The Festival
events.summary: Holy Name Convent's Phoenix The Festival returned as a food-inclusive cooler experience with a soca-artiste lineup. The event page confirmed January 17, 2026 at 2 Queen's Park East, Port of Spain.

events.title: National Junior Panorama Finals 2026
events.summary: Pan Trinbago confirmed the National Junior Panorama Finals for January 18, 2026 at Queen's Park Savannah. The steelpan finals featured 21 & Under and 19 & Under categories.

events.title: D'Kaiso Dynasty
events.summary: D'Kaiso Dynasty was a TUCO calypso-tent night at the Radisson Hotel on Wrightson Road. The January 31 listing named a large cast including Brother Valentino, Gypsy, Karene Asche, Yung Bredda, Rikki Jai, Preedy and others.

events.title: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend
events.summary: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend bundled three official events from January 23–25, 2026: Iron Park, wOw Carnival Market and Soaka Till Sunrise. The festival focused on Carnival music, steelpan culture, DJs, paint, powder and soca energy.

events.title: Soca Village - For the Love of Soca Music
events.summary: House of Siete's Soca Village was positioned as a throwback soca fete focused on soca from the 1980s through the present. Island E-Tickets confirmed it for January 24–25, 2026 at Rock Back, Chaguaramas.

events.title: QRC Fete: Ramajay
events.summary: QRC Events confirmed Fete Royal: Ramajay as a Carnival 2026 fete at Queen's Royal College Grounds. The event was scheduled for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:30 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: Fete Gala
events.summary: Fete Gala was listed as an all-inclusive Carnival experience at Queen's Park Oval. Soca News confirmed the event for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: SOTU presents Enamour
events.summary: SOTU presented Enamour at Club Vice on Cipriani Boulevard. The listing described Enamour's sound as deep house, progressive and dark techno, with the event running January 31–February 1, 2026.

data.notes: February 2026 in Port of Spain was dominated by Trinidad Carnival week, with the strongest verified music programming centered on steelpan, calypso, mas and soca fetes around Queen’s Park Savannah and nearby venues.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals: Savannah Party
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s Savannah Party presented the Medium and Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals for National Panorama 2026, with Grand Stand viewing and North Stand party options at Queen’s Park Savannah.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Medium Conventional Band Finals
events.summary: The rescheduled National Panorama Medium Conventional Band Finals took place at Queen’s Park Savannah with free public admission and featured the country’s leading medium steel orchestras.

events.title: Monday Madness 2026: Soca Insanity
events.summary: Machel Montano’s tour listing confirms Monday Madness 2026 at Queen’s Park Oval; the Carnival-week concert/fete was billed as Soca Insanity and featured Machel with The Monk Band.

events.title: KES IZWE Festival 2026: Roots & Riddim
events.summary: KES’s IZWE Festival returned to Queen’s Park Savannah under the Roots & Riddim banner, presenting a Carnival festival experience built around live music, food, art and culture.

events.title: LIME 2026: The Ultimate Carnival Fete
events.summary: LIME 2026 was the Hyatt Regency Trinidad’s ultra all-inclusive Carnival Wednesday fete, with a 2026 entertainment bill including Kes The Band, Ravi B & Karma, Farmer Nappy, Destra, Mical Teja, Machel Montano and others.

events.title: Punchy Wednesday 2026: The Championship
events.summary: Punchy Wednesday 2026 was a Carnival Wednesday all-inclusive cooler fete and DJ/band performance event at Queen’s Park Oval, listed by TriniJungleJuice from 9 PM to 4 AM.

events.title: TRIBE Ignite: Carnival Thursday
events.summary: TRIBE Ignite was a Carnival Thursday drinks-inclusive fete at the Hasely Crawford Stadium Training Field, with the event page highlighting Kes The Band as part of the entertainment lineup.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Large Conventional Band Finals
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s Large Conventional Band Finals brought eleven major steel orchestras to Queen’s Park Savannah for the flagship National Panorama final on Carnival Saturday.

events.title: Dimanche Gras 2026
events.summary: Dimanche Gras 2026 was staged at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah from Sunday night into Monday morning, combining pageantry, music, calypso and Carnival royalty presentations before Carnival Monday.

events.title: J’ouvert Morning 2026 with Dirty Dozen J’ouvert
events.summary: Dirty Dozen J’ouvert’s 2026 all-inclusive J’ouvert experience took place in Port of Spain on Carnival Monday morning, including the DDJ pre-party, road experience and signature after-party.

events.title: Senior Parade of the Bands 2026
events.summary: Presented by the Trinidad and Tobago Carnival Bands Association, the Senior Parade of the Bands was the two-day centrepiece of Trinidad Carnival 2026, with masquerade bands crossing at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah.

events.title: Carnival Lagniappe 2026
events.summary: Carnival Lagniappe 2026 was billed by Pan Trinbago as a post-Carnival grand finale featuring champions of Carnival across steelpan, mas, calypso, soca and related traditions.

data.notes: January is confirmed as Port of Spain’s pre-Carnival build-up, with soca fetes, boat rides, J’ouvert-style parties and Panorama steelpan events leading into Carnival week.

events.title: Savannah Party - Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals: National Panorama 2027
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen’s Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago presents the National Panorama 2027 Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals at Queen’s Park Savannah, one of the core steelpan events of the Carnival build-up.

events.title: Medium Conventional Band FINALS - National Panorama 2027
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen’s Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s National Panorama 2027 Medium Conventional Band Finals are confirmed for Queen’s Park Savannah on January 31.

events.title: Soaka Till Sunrise
events.summary: Soaka Till Sunrise is listed as the signature Soaka weekend paint-and-powder fete, running 3:00 AM to 10:00 AM at O2 Park.

events.title: Iron Park - Trinidad Big Soaka Weekend
events.summary: Part of the Soaka Arts & Music Festival weekend, Iron Park is billed around steelband clashes, rhythm sections, DJs and soca at Fatima Grounds.

events.title: Soka in Moka 2027: Enchanted
events.summary: Soka in Moka returns as an all-inclusive Carnival fete at Trinity College, Moka, with food, drinks and non-stop entertainment listed for the evening.

events.title: FETEYARD 2027
events.summary: The Lost Tribe’s fifth Fete Yard edition continues its annual cooler-party concept celebrating Carnival culture through masquerade themes and a larger year-five buildout.

events.title: 1ST JAM 2027
events.summary: SCORCH opens the Carnival-season party calendar with a Port-of-Spain DJ/truck-focused fete billed as “the first movement of the season.”

events.title: Phoenix the Festival 2027
events.venueName: Holy Name Convent, Queen's Park East
events.summary: Phoenix marks its 9th year as a food-inclusive cooler experience in support of Holy Name Convent, with a Soca-artiste lineup and Carnival-party format announced.

events.title: EDAY
events.summary: Erphaan Alves Live lists EDAY as a Port of Spain Carnival-season event running from the evening of January 31 into February 1.

events.title: SOCA NRG International Final: Trinidad 2027
events.venueName: Venue announced closer to the date
events.summary: A three-day international soca dance championship and Caribbean dance-fitness festival weekend bringing qualified dancers from the Caribbean, USA, Canada, UK, Europe, and beyond to Trinidad & Tobago.

events.title: Rum and Music | Cruizin Down D Islands 27
events.summary: Rum and Music’s pre-Carnival DDI cruise advertises two boats, an island stop, local and international DJs, and cooler-fete energy on the water.

events.title: FETE GALA V ALL INCLUSIVE
events.summary: Life Events celebrates five years of Fete Gala with an all-inclusive Carnival-season fete at Queen’s Park Oval.

events.title: RISE - Nasty Jouvert
events.summary: Chill Out Events’ RISE - Nasty Jouvert is confirmed for O2 Park with paint, powder, water and foam; the organizer lists soca, jab, bouyon and dancehall as the soundtrack.

events.title: TRINI SOCA CRUISE
events.summary: VEE TEAM PROMOTIONS, CARNIVAL MAN, 868 ENTERTAINMENT and IZSO PROMOTIONS present a Saturday afternoon soca cruise from Harbour Master in Cocorite.

events.title: French Toast Breakfast Experience: Tribal Oasis
events.summary: House of Siete’s breakfast fete positions itself as an official early-season Carnival breakfast experience, with heritage, food, rhythm, and morning party energy at Queen’s Hall.

events.title: CIAO - Hello Carnival Bikini Breakfast Cooler Cruise
events.summary: Darren Hart & friends present a Carnival breakfast cooler cruise from Harbour Master in Cocorite, with DJs and a 10:00 AM sail time listed by the organizer.

events.title: LAVA ON WATER
events.summary: Lava Brands & Entertainment presents Lava On Water - 2 Wild, an animal-print themed Carnival boat party on Harbour Master.

events.title: Booze&Bacchanal FIRST JAM
events.summary: Carnival Plug’s four-hour Harbour Master cooler cruise brands itself as a legendary Booze&Bacchanal January Jam with nonstop music, drinks, and boat-party energy.

data.notes: February 2027 is Carnival month in Port of Spain, with the confirmed calendar concentrated around soca fetes, J’Ouvert, Panorama steelpan, and the Feb. 8–9 road climax.

events.title: Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.venueName: Port of Spain streets / Queen's Park Savannah
events.summary: Official tourism listing confirms Trinidad’s Carnival road days for Monday, February 8 and Tuesday, February 9, 2027. Expect masquerade bands, soca and calypso sound systems, and the main Port of Spain street parade atmosphere.

events.title: Soca Brainwash Music Festival: A Pirate’s Tale
events.summary: DJ Private Ryan’s Soca Brainwash is confirmed for Carnival Saturday, February 6, at St Mary's Grounds. The listing gives the 2027 theme as “A Pirate’s Tale.”

events.title: LIME: The Ultimate Carnival Fete
events.summary: Hyatt LIME is confirmed for February 3, 2027 at Hyatt Regency Trinidad. The official page describes the all-inclusive Carnival Wednesday fete with soca, calypso and chutney entertainment, premium food and waterfront production.

events.title: National Panorama 2027 — Large Conventional Band Finals
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen's Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago confirms the Large Conventional Band Finals of National Panorama 2027 for February 6 at Queen’s Park Savannah. This is the flagship steelpan competition night of the Carnival season.

events.title: IZ WE 2027: Roots, Rock, Soca — We Coming Home
events.summary: Kes The Band’s Carnival-season cultural concert is confirmed at Queen’s Park Savannah, with the listing describing a Main Stage headlined by Kes and additional artists and DJs.

events.title: TRIBE Ignite — Olympia 2027
events.summary: TRIBE Carnival confirms its Ignite Olympia fete for Carnival Thursday from February 4 into February 5. The listing promises soca artistes, top DJs, premium drinks and a white/gold/silver dress code.

events.title: Dimanche Gras — Senior Kings and Queens Finals 2027
events.summary: The National Carnival Commission calendar confirms Dimanche Gras Senior Kings and Queens Finals for February 7 at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah. It is the major Carnival Sunday stage event before J’Ouvert and the road days.

events.title: A.M.BEACH CLUB '27
events.summary: Caesar’s Army confirms A.M.BEACH CLUB for Carnival Thursday, February 4. The listing describes a North Coast beach-club experience with soca, premium drinks, Caribbean cuisine and local/international DJs.

events.title: AWOL TT 2027
events.summary: AWOL’s Carnival Thursday cooler cruise is confirmed for February 4 at Harts Cut, Chaguaramas. The event page lists 9:00 AM boarding and 10:00 AM sailing.

events.title: Citrus Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.summary: Illusions, Private Ryan and Radiance Productions list this premium all-inclusive tropical Carnival Wednesday fete at Green Meadows in nearby Santa Cruz. The event page highlights DJs, Caribbean food and premium drinks.

events.title: WE J'ouvert Band
events.summary: WE J’ouvert confirms its all-inclusive band will touch road from the heart of Port of Spain on Carnival Monday, February 8, 2027. The package includes a soca music truck, breakfast, drinks, paint, powder, water truck and security.

events.title: DJ JEL: Jus'so Fete 2027 — The Night Market
events.summary: DJ JEL’s Jus'so Fete is confirmed at SoundForge Woodbrook from February 3 into February 4. The food-inclusive night market concept pairs Trinidadian food, drinks and soca in Port of Spain.

events.title: Carnival Lagniappe — 2027 Champs
events.summary: Pan Trinbago lists Carnival Lagniappe — 2027 Champs for February 13 at the Grand Stand, Queen’s Park Savannah. The post-Carnival steelpan event presents the 2027 champions under the National Panorama banner.

events.title: Hennessy Pure White 2027
events.summary: Harbour Master lists Pure White 2027 for February 4, presented with Lyrikal and Viking Ding Dong. It is billed as a premium all-white Carnival boatride.

events.title: Frolic: Rhythm of Our People
events.venueName: Fete Yard, Queen's Hall, St. Ann's
events.summary: Frolic returns on Carnival Friday at Fete Yard, Queen’s Hall, from February 5 into February 6. The listing describes a food-inclusive cooler fete with performances from major soca names.

events.title: IMAGINE 'Jouvert Gems'
events.summary: DJ Private Ryan presents a Carnival Sunday evening J’ouvert-style experience built around paint, oil, mud, powder, water and riddim.

events.title: J'lime Trinidad Carnival 2027
events.summary: Pumpers Inc confirms J’lime at Mille Fleurs from February 3 into February 4. The listing bills it as a premium drinks-inclusive soca event with gourmet tapas and live up-close performances.

events.title: Hard Fete — Fete Harder!
events.summary: Hard Fete is confirmed in Port of Spain from February 5 into February 6. The event page bills it directly as a power-soca experience.

events.title: Lime at the Hyatt
events.summary: All-white Carnival-week all-inclusive fete listed as a Platinum-ticket upgrade for Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027, positioned as an early-week premium diaspora/soca kickoff before the main road days.

events.title: Sahara J’ouvert 27
events.summary: Orange-themed J’ouvert road party in Woodbrook promising Jamaican DJs, paint, drinks, and Carnival Monday road energy from midnight to morning.

events.title: Sunny Side Up Breakfast Party
events.summary: Confirmed as the Sunday all-inclusive breakfast fete in the Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027 package, Sunny Side Up fits the sunrise/breakfast-party lane that anchors Carnival-week fete culture.

events.title: Phuket All-Inclusive
events.summary: A Friday Carnival-week all-inclusive fete included in the Ultimate Trinidad Carnival 2027 premium experience, geared toward the food-and-drinks-inclusive soca/fete circuit rather than arena programming.

data.notes: June is anchored by Reykjavík Arts Festival’s contemporary and classical program, with Harpa adding headline pop concerts later in the month.

events.title: Close-up – Hildur Guðnadóttir & Iceland Symphony Orchestra
events.summary: The Iceland Symphony Orchestra presents an evening with composer Hildur Guðnadóttir, featuring her music from films including Joker, Tár and A Haunting in Venice alongside works by key influences.

events.title: Hildur Guðnadóttir – Where to From
events.summary: Hildur Guðnadóttir performs Where to From for the first time in Iceland at Harpa’s Silfurberg, alongside earlier works and an ensemble including Liam Byrne, Peyee Chen, Nina Guo, Sarah Saviet and Clare O’Connell.

events.title: John Grant
events.summary: Reykjavík Arts Festival presents John Grant at Harpa’s Eldborg, billed as his first major concert in Iceland in many years.

events.title: Reykjavík Arts Festival: Angel Blue
events.summary: American soprano Angel Blue performs with pianist Bryan Wagorn on the closing day of Reykjavík Arts Festival, with a program spanning Fauré, Debussy, Strauss, Gershwin and African American spirituals.

events.title: Fischersund: A Night of Scent & Music
events.summary: Fischersund brings its scented-concert concept to Reykjavík with Jónsi, Sin Fang and Kjartan Holm performing compositions tied to the house’s fragrances, with video works by Ingibjörg Birgisdóttir.

events.title: Katie Melua
events.summary: Katie Melua performs at Harpa’s Eldborg with her group, in a concert advertised as featuring her best-known songs.

events.title: 10cc
events.summary: 10cc, led by founding member Graham Gouldman with the current touring band, performs at Harpa’s Eldborg with a set built around the group’s classic pop catalogue.

events.title: Volume x I/0 present: Adrianna, Cranz
events.summary: Independence Day eve club night across three stages of techno, house and drum & bass, pairing international guests Adrianna and Cranz with a large local Reykjavík lineup including a:wide, Balatron, Samwise, Tomashevsky and Young G&T.

events.title: La Poblana Fest 5th Anniversary
events.summary: La Poblana’s fifth-anniversary night with Kumbiavik Collective brings live cumbia, sonidero culture, tropical vinyl energy and Afro-Latin/global club selections from La Dimensión, Sonido Fin and Suma Phayiri B2B La Contra.

events.title: Stefán Hilmarsson – 26.06.26
events.summary: Icelandic singer Stefán Hilmarsson marks a major birthday and a forty-year career milestone with two Eldborg concerts featuring a full band, brass section and special guests.

events.title: Reykjavík Arts Festival Closing Party
events.summary: The festival hub closes with DJ Choconilla and dj Lui playing African-inspired selections including amapiano, afrobeat and pop, followed by DJ 101 Savage with live visuals.

events.title: LOVE LOVE
events.summary: LOVE LOVE is a Reykjavík Arts Festival premiere by Arnbjörg María Danielsen, created with Leah Marojević, Ensemble Adapter and electronic musician Salka Valsdóttir, blending sound, movement, bodies, objects and electronics.

events.title: Niður – an Icelandic Circus on Ljósagangur
events.summary: Skerpla – Experimental Sound Lab presents an Icelandic version of John Cage’s Roaratorio concept, transforming Dagur Hjartarson’s novel Ljósagangur into an installation and live musical performance.

events.title: Bed By 10pm Is Coming To Reykjavik!
events.summary: Touring early-evening 30+ club brand brings its resident-DJ party format to Gamla Bíó, built around 80s, 90s and early-2000s club classics, visuals, confetti and dancefloor nostalgia.

events.title: viibra: Venutian Wetland
events.summary: The flute septet viibra performs Venutian Wetland, a new sound-and-movement work by Bergrún Snæbjörnsdóttir and choreographer Margrét Bjarnadóttir, as part of Reykjavík Arts Festival.

events.title: Mikael Máni Trio feat. Henrik Linder & Magnús T. Elíassen
events.summary: A compact jazz-scene date for guitarist Mikael Máni’s Half Sun tour, featuring Dirty Loops bassist Henrik Linder and drummer Magnús Trygvason Elíassen of ADHD/Moses Hightower.

events.title: POPera + Diana Burkot DJ Set
events.summary: Free Reykjavík Arts Festival performance described as club-kid culture meeting classical instrumentation, with producer/DJ Diana Burkot and performer Michael Richardt, followed by Burkot’s Rosemary Loves a Blackberry DJ set.

events.title: OYAMA x SUPERSERIOUS x SPACESTATION í Tónabíó
events.summary: Three-act local Reykjavík indie/shoegaze and indie-pop bill at Tónabíó, bringing together OYAMA, SUPERSERIOUS and SPACESTATION for a non-arena snapshot of the city’s guitar-pop scene.

events.title: Heimstónlistarhátíð fjölskyldunnar í Hörpu / Family World Music Festival at Harpa
events.summary: Daytime world-music festival at Harpa with participatory music and culture from regions including West Africa, East Asia, Central and Eastern Europe, and Central and South America, designed as a free-flowing diversity-focused gathering.

events.title: Bond. Jazz Bond.
events.summary: Rannveig Káradóttir fronts a sextet of Icelandic jazz players in jazz and funk arrangements of James Bond themes, arranged by Peter Aisher and staged downtown at Tjarnarbíó.

data.notes: Confirmed July listings are still relatively sparse, with Harpa/Hallgrímskirkja summer programming and David Byrne’s arena show standing out among announced dates.

events.title: David Byrne — Who Is The Sky? Tour
events.summary: David Byrne brings the Who Is The Sky? Tour to Laugardalshöll with Ghost Train Orchestra on July 29. The Tix event page confirms the Reykjavík concert date and 20:00 start time.

events.title: JóiPé X Króli
events.summary: Icelandic duo JóiPé and Króli perform with their band at Háskólabíó on July 24. The Tix listing confirms the 20:00 show in Háskólabíó - Salur 1.

events.title: Latin Night in Iceland – Salsa Baúl Caracas
events.summary: Ticketed Latin diaspora dance night at Sykursalurinn with two Venezuelan DJs: DJ Jeam el Salsoso opening with classic salsa from 20:00, followed by DJ Gato Beat with salsa, bachata, merengue, and Latino party sounds until 03:00; 21+ event.

events.title: Jazz by the Harbour: Ragnheiður Gröndal and Guðmundur Pétursson
events.summary: A free monthly live-jazz residency at Hafnartorg Gallery food hall; the July edition features Icelandic vocalist Ragnheiður Gröndal with guitarist Guðmundur Pétursson, running 19:00–20:00.

events.title: With Four Hands & Four Feet — Opening Concert of the Organ Summer
events.summary: Hallgrímskirkja organists Björn Steinar Sólbergsson and Steinar Logi Helgason open the Organ Summer series by performing on both the Klais concert organ and Frobenius choir organ. The program includes works by Gigout, Pachelbel, J. B. Bach, Jón Nordal, Ravel and Þorkell Sigurbjörnsson.

events.title: Midday Music in Harpa
events.summary: Harpa’s July daytime concert series runs from July 2–31 in Eldborg, with Icelandic musicians performing acoustic songs on the Eldborg stage. The source explicitly lists multiple 11:00 and 12:00 performances across the month.

data.notes: August 2026 in Reykjavík is unusually strong around the solar eclipse, with Björk’s Echolalia, Árstíðir’s eclipse concert, and Reykjavík Jazz anchoring the month.

events.title: Echolalia – Eclipse x Exhibition Festival
events.summary: Björk hosts a one-day solar-eclipse festival very near Reykjavík with DJ sets by Björk and Arca plus Ronja and Sideproject, tied to Björk’s National Gallery exhibition and Smekkleysa’s 40th birthday.

events.title: Reykjavík Jazz Festival
events.summary: Reykjavík Jazz Festival runs August 25–30 across venues including Harpa, Fantasía, Austurbær and Iðnó, with confirmed artists including Ingi Bjarni Quartet, Kosmonauci, Tom Sochas Trio, Matti Klein Soul Trio, LILJA and Anna Gréta.

events.title: Stórtónleikar Ásgeirs Trausta í Eldborg
events.summary: Ásgeir plays a major Eldborg concert celebrating his album Julia, with songs from across his Icelandic and English-language catalogue plus new material from an upcoming Icelandic-language album.

events.title: Culture Night / Menningarnótt
events.summary: Reykjavík’s largest city festival is confirmed for August 22, with city-centre cultural programming that traditionally includes concerts, choirs, DJs, street performances and fireworks.

events.title: Árstíðir – Sólmyrkvi
events.summary: Árstíðir perform a special eclipse-themed concert in central Reykjavík on the night before the total solar eclipse, with a contemplative programme drawing on Icelandic traditions.

events.title: Aurelio Voltaire á Iðnó
events.summary: Aurelio Voltaire returns to Iceland for a third time, performing his songs at IÐNÓ after more than 30 years of touring as a musician and multidisciplinary artist.

events.title: Salsaball með Barrio 27
events.summary: Barrio 27, a 16-piece salsa band, hosts its first full salsa dance night at the former NASA venue, beginning with a beginner lesson before the live set.

events.title: LATIN NIGHT IN ICELAND!
events.summary: A Latin dance night at Sykursalurinn with DJ Gato Beat from Venezuela and DJ Juanjo Vivanco from Spain, running from salsa, bachata and merengue into late-night perreo.

events.title: Reykjavík International Piano Festival
events.summary: The inaugural Reykjavík International Piano Festival runs August 3–12 with masterclasses, workshops and public performance opportunities at Harpa Concert Hall.

data.notes: September 2026 is anchored by experimental/electronic festival Extreme Chill, the Vaka folk gathering, and several large Icelandic pop/hip-hop anniversary shows.

events.title: Quarashi
events.summary: Quarashi celebrate their 30th anniversary with a major Laugardalshöll concert, promising their best-known songs and special guests from the band’s career.

events.title: Extreme Chill Festival 2026
events.summary: Extreme Chill returns to Reykjavík for its 17th year, focusing on experimental, electronic and ambient music across four days in the city center.

events.title: Aron Can - 10 ár á einu kvöldi
events.summary: Icelandic rapper Aron Can marks 10 years since his first album Þekkir Stráginn with one major anniversary concert at Laugardalshöll.

events.title: Joep Beving - Liminal Tour
events.summary: Dutch pianist and composer Joep Beving brings his Liminal Tour to Fríkirkjan í Reykjavík, with Sóley Stefánsdóttir listed as special guest.

events.title: Magnús Jóhann 30 ára - Stórtónleikar í Háskólabíó
events.summary: Pianist and composer Magnús Jóhann Ragnarsson celebrates his 30th birthday and 10 years since his debut solo album with a large Háskólabíó concert featuring collaborators including GDRN and jazz guests.

events.title: Vaka Folk Festival 2026
events.summary: Vaka Traditional Folk Arts Association confirms its annual flagship Vaka Folk Festival will be held in Reykjavík from September 14–20, 2026.

events.title: Mania: The ABBA Tribute
events.summary: The touring ABBA tribute show Mania plays Eldborg at Harpa, presenting a full-band recreation of ABBA’s hits.

events.title: Shrek Rave Is Coming To Reykjavik!
events.summary: Touring novelty rave brand landing at Gamla Bío with DJs playing techno, house, EDM, drum & bass and Shrek remixes, plus stage performers, visuals and themed games.

events.title: Sycamore Tree / 10 ára afmælistónleikar
events.venueName: Harpa Concert Hall and Conference Centre
events.summary: Icelandic duo Sycamore Tree mark their 10th anniversary with a Harpa concert listed for 20:00 on September 4, 2026.

events.title: RVKBear 2026 Weekend
events.venueName: Various Reykjavík venues, including Kiki Queer Bar, Bar 22 and Petersen Svítan
events.summary: Queer bear-scene weekend with official parties and events including the Thursday Welcome Party, Friday Top-off Party, Saturday Mr. Bear Contest & Party, plus VIP access and happy hour at Kiki Queer Bar and Bar 22.

data.notes: November is anchored by Iceland Airwaves, with its showcase-festival core spilling into special electronic, hip-hop, pop and local-scene events before and after the main weekend.

events.title: Iceland Airwaves 2026
events.summary: Reykjavík’s flagship multi-venue showcase festival returns with an official program across downtown venues. Confirmed artists include 9m88, Agent Fresco, Cell7, Cobrah, David Bay, Emmsjé Gauti, Jamie Woon, MAMMÚT, Sísý Ey, Skeler, The Itch, Warhaus and many more.

events.title: The Streets with Úlfur Úlfur
events.summary: The Streets close the Airwaves run at Eldborg, Harpa, performing A Grand Don’t Come For Free in full with additional catalogue tracks. Icelandic rap duo Úlfur Úlfur open the night.

events.title: GusGus at Austurbæjarbíó
events.summary: Iceland Airwaves and GusGus present an electronic partner event from 22:00–03:00. The schedule lists DJ Margeir, a midnight GusGus live set and Exos live at 02:00.

events.title: Daði Freyr & The Iceland Symphony Orchestra
events.summary: Daði Freyr performs with the Iceland Symphony Orchestra for the first time in an Iceland Airwaves special event at Eldborg, Harpa. The program reimagines his synth-pop songs with orchestral arrangements and includes music from his upcoming album.

events.title: Shygirl with Alaska & Joey Christ
events.summary: Iceland Airwaves presents Shygirl for a separate-ticket IA26 special event, with local support from Alaska and Joey Christ. The show is billed as an experimental pop, club and hip-hop event on the night before the main festival opens.

events.title: Iceland Airwaves Conference 2026
events.summary: The Airwaves music-industry conference runs 09:00–18:00 across two days, with panels on live music, showcase festivals, sustainability, music curation and Iceland’s music export ecosystem. It is held in collaboration with Iceland Music, Reykjavík Music City and Business Iceland.

events.title: AFROFEST: Luis Lucas DJ Set
events.summary: A Reykjavík Dance Festival diaspora club/performance crossover: staged Afrobeats × Amapiano DJ set with live dance, centered on Nigerian, South African and wider African-diaspora club culture.

events.title: MYRKRAEYJA – Danspartý, performansar & DJ / SHADOWS
events.summary: Reykjavík Dance Festival closing dance party led by Kanema and Luis, foregrounding dance, performance and DJ culture with amapiano, afrobeat, pop and other cross-diaspora influences.

events.title: HAM - Endalok alls
events.summary: HAM celebrate the release of their album Endalok alls with a concert at Eldborg, Harpa. The set is announced to include new songs, older material and guest performers Úlfur Eldjárn, Steinunn Eldflaug Harðardóttir and Kristjana Stefánsdóttir.

events.title: TODMOBILE – HÁPUNKTAR
events.summary: Icelandic pop-rock band Todmobile play a career-spanning celebratory concert at Eldborg after receiving honorary recognition at the Icelandic Music Awards. The lineup features the band plus guests including Jónína Björt Gunnarsdóttir, Söngsveitin Filharmónía, Strokkvartettinn Siggi and Guðni Franzson.

events.title: Iceland’s Liberation Orchestra featuring Davíð Þór Jónsson - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub date built around a new Haukur Gröndal piano concerto for Davíð Þór Jónsson and ensemble, balancing composed material with free improvisation from leading Icelandic jazz players.

events.title: Upprásin | Spouses, Brenninetla, ÞESAL
events.summary: Harpa’s grassroots Icelandic music series Upprásin presents Spouses, Brenninetla and ÞESAL in Kaldalón. The series is run with Reykjavík Music City and Rás 2 to spotlight emerging Icelandic acts across genres.

events.title: Sigurður Flosason Quartet - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Veteran saxophonist Sigurður Flosason leads a quartet through modern jazz rooted in bebop, with Anna Gréta Sigurðardóttir, Birgir Steinn Theódórsson and Einar Scheving.

events.title: Andrés Þór Trio – Relocate - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub’s November opener at Björtuloft, Harpa, featuring Andrés Þór’s trio around the 2026 album Relocate with improvisation-led guitar-trio material.

events.title: Björn Thoroddsen Band - Múlinn Jazzclub
events.summary: Múlinn Jazzclub presents Icelandic guitarist Björn Thoroddsen with Jón Rafnsson on bass and Fúsi Óttars on drums. Harpa bills the night as jazz and blues, with Thoroddsen moving across pop, jazz, rock, blues and country influences.

events.title: PVBR & Poetic Funk present Winter Gathering 2026 Iceland
events.summary: A three-day funk, soul and groove weekender from Positive Vibrations Reykjavik and Poetic Funk, with all-day parties on November 20–21 and a recreation day on November 22; announced DJs include Atjazz, DJ Fraggle, Tommi and Ingvar, with sounds spanning funk, soul, boogie, jazz, Latin, afro beat, bruk beat and soulful/funky house.

data.notes: As of current listings, Reykjavík’s June 2027 club and festival programmes are mostly not yet announced; only firmly confirmed in-scope contemporary music events are included.

events.title: JóiPé & Króli í 10 ár!
events.summary: Icelandic hip-hop/pop duo JóiPé & Króli celebrate 10 years with two Eldborg shows at Harpa on June 4, 2027. The event page notes they have been among Iceland’s most popular musicians since 2017 and are known for energetic live performances.

events.title: 2027 CMS International Conference
events.venueName: Listaháskóli Íslands (Iceland Academy of the Arts)
events.summary: The College Music Society’s 2027 International Conference is confirmed for Reykjavík with the theme “Engaging Creative Pathways: Dialogues, Connections, and Crossings in Music.” The programme call includes performance-focused formats, including an Iceland Ensemble-in-Residence and site-specific music events.

data.notes: No confirmed in-scope November 2027 Reykjavík music events were found on searched primary or reputable event calendars yet.
January 2026 in Rio centered on summer festival programming, pre-Carnival samba rehearsals, and a strong run of electronic boat/beach parties.

events.title: Amazoul Beach Party
events.summary: Amazoul opened the year with a beach-club edition at Reserva featuring Classmatic, Vivi Santana, Marian, Lowderz and Filhos Crew. The RA listing describes the event as a tech-house/electronica beach party running from 15:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Roupa Nova at Vivo Rio
events.summary: Brazilian pop-rock institution Roupa Nova played Vivo Rio on January 10 at 19:00. Bandsintown lists the show at Vivo Rio with pop and rock tags.

events.title: Insônia Festival 2026
events.summary: Insônia Festival ran for two days in Jacarepaguá with a psytrance/electronic lineup including Major7, Becker, Shanti People, X-Noize, Paranormal Attack and Fernanda Pistelli. JamBase lists the dates, venue and day-by-day lineup.

events.title: Festival Polifonia de Verão
events.summary: The 11th edition of Festival Polifonia launched a summer edition at Vivo Rio with Supercombo, Kamaitachi, Karen Jonz, Dibob and Catch Side. Riotur lists the January 11 event, lineup highlights, venue and 15:00 start time.

events.title: Universo Spanta 2026
events.summary: Universo Spanta returned to Marina da Glória from January 12 to 25 with a Brazilian-music lineup spanning samba, pop, funk, rap, forró and MPB. Riotur lists highlights including BK’, BaianaSystem, Ana Castela, MC Cabelinho, Dennis DJ, Ivete Sangalo, Joelma, Gloria Groove, Ludmilla, Xande de Pilares and Filipe Ret.

events.title: Bicuda x Kode — Verão Inabalável
events.summary: RA picked this queer underground club night at TRAUMA, bringing Rio and São Paulo labels Bicuda and Kode together. The lineup included Ananda, Gigios, M4fel, Miguel Arcanjo, PEDROVISK, Quimera, Victin and Zei.

events.title: Cocada Boat
events.summary: Cocada Boat staged a summer-season house and disco cruise from Marina da Glória. Resident Advisor lists Leo Janeiro, Marta Supernova, The Checkup and Balahaus on the lineup.

events.title: Maria Bethânia at Vivo Rio
events.summary: Maria Bethânia played Vivo Rio on January 17 at 19:00. Ticketmaster Brazil listed the Rio de Janeiro performance date, venue and door/show times.

events.title: Club Are: On The Sea
events.summary: London queer club-night series Club Are brought its first Rio boat-party edition to Quadrado da Urca. RA lists Omoloko, Alírio, MIKA and source:link on the lineup, with sounds ranging from tech house to progressive and hard house.

events.title: Carnaval 2026: Série Ouro Technical Rehearsals
events.summary: Rio’s Série Ouro samba schools held official technical rehearsals across three nights at the Sambódromo. The Riotur/Carnaval.rio schedule lists schools including Unidos de Padre Miguel, União da Ilha do Governador, Império Serrano, Estácio de Sá and others.

events.title: Ensaios da Anitta 2026 — Rio de Janeiro
events.summary: Anitta brought her pre-Carnival Ensaios da Anitta tour to Riocentro on January 25, with doors listed at 15:00. Songkick lists the date, venue and tour name; Brazilian coverage later reported guests including Pedro Sampaio, Melody and MC Cabelinho.

events.title: Arena 3 Anos
events.summary: Arena marked three years with an RA-picked club night at TRAUMA focused on techno and baile-funk-adjacent global bass. The lineup included NORA, Anti Ribeiro, Cuca, Mariah Miranda, Total XTC, ZEI and KBRAL.

data.notes: February 2026 in Rio was dominated by Carnival, with the Sambadrome, street megablocos, luxury balls, and a parallel wave of international electronic parties around the waterfront.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2026
events.summary: Rio Carnival 2026 ran from February 13 to 21, turning the city into its annual samba, blocos, balls, and parade epicenter. The official festival period anchored the month’s music-travel calendar.

events.title: Rio Carnival 2026 — Grupo Especial Samba School Parades
events.summary: The elite Grupo Especial samba school parades took place across three nights, February 15–17, at Marquês de Sapucaí. The lineup included major schools such as Mangueira, Beija-Flor, Viradouro, Grande Rio, and Salgueiro.

events.title: Baile do Copa BR
events.summary: The Copacabana Palace Carnival gala took place on February 14 at 22:00 with the theme “Ponto Br.” The long-running luxury ball centered on Brazilian carnival culture, costumes, and live party atmosphere.

events.title: Carnaboma 2026 Grand Opening: Jamie Jones
events.summary: BOMA opened its Carnival run at Museu do Amanhã on February 13 with Jamie Jones, Adam Ten b2b Mita Gami, Miguelle & Tons, and Giu. The night launched the electronic-programming counterpoint to Carnival week.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: Black Coffee
events.summary: BOMA’s February 14 Carnival date at Museu do Amanhã featured Black Coffee with Ahmed Spins, Carlita, Bhaskar, Jackson, Malive, and Unfazed. The lineup made it one of the week’s strongest afro-house and house bookings.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: Mochakk & Dennis Cruz
events.summary: BOMA’s February 16 party at Museu do Amanhã featured Mochakk, Dennis Cruz, Bob Moses club set, OSGEMEOS, and Halfcab. The event was billed as an all-night-into-sunrise Carnival edition.

events.title: BOMA Carnival: ARTBAT + CamelPhat
events.summary: ARTBAT and CamelPhat headlined BOMA’s February 17–18 Carnival night, joined by LP Giobbi, Departamento, and Tato. The booking leaned into melodic, cinematic club music at the waterfront museum.

events.title: CarnaRIO 2026: Vintage Culture
events.summary: BOMA’s Champions Friday event on February 20 featured Vintage Culture, WhoMadeWho hybrid DJ set, OMRI, Eli Iwasa, and Doozie. The date linked Rio’s post-parade Champions weekend with a major Brazilian electronic headliner.

events.title: Dawn Patrol by BOMA — Carnival Edition
events.summary: BOMA’s Dawn Patrol closing edition at Museu do Amanhã featured MAZ, ANTDOT, Riascode, Bakka, and special guest Kölsch. The event was billed for Saturday, February 21, running late-night into sunrise.

events.title: Camarote Nº1 2026
events.summary: Camarote Nº1 operated as a premium Sapucaí Carnival party during the samba school parades; this entry uses the explicitly listed February 15 date. The official page confirms its 2026 schedule across parade nights with open bar, food, and party programming.

events.title: Bloco da Anitta
events.venueName: Rua Primeiro de Março / Circuito Preta Gil
events.summary: Anitta’s bloco paraded through downtown Rio on February 21, with gatherings starting at 7:00 on Rua Primeiro de Março. Riotur described the show as one of the biggest and most anticipated events on the Rio street-Carnival calendar.

events.title: Baile Sinfônico: Monobloco & Orquestra Petrobras Sinfônica
events.summary: Monobloco and Orquestra Petrobras Sinfônica presented Baile Sinfônico at Fundição Progresso on February 20. The concert reworked Monobloco’s carnival repertoire with symphonic arrangements under conductor Felipe Prazeres.

data.notes: March 2026 skewed toward arena and theater-scale touring shows in Rio, with a smaller but active underground electronic calendar around Centro, Vidigal, and Trauma.

events.title: Macy Gray - Rio de Janeiro
events.summary: Macy Gray brought her Turnê de Verão 2026 to Vivo Rio, with the source listing a March 5 show at 21:30. The billing focused on her soul/R&B catalog, including a full-album presentation of On How Life Is.

events.title: Bryan Adams - World: Roll With The Punches
events.summary: Bryan Adams’ official tour page listed Qualistage, Rio de Janeiro for March 6, 2026 on the World: Roll With The Punches tour. This was the Rio stop on his South American run following dates in Mexico.

events.title: Jason Mraz - Return to South America Tour
events.summary: Jason Mraz played Vivo Rio on March 6, 2026, as part of his Return to South America Tour. Ticketmaster listed doors at 19:30 and show time at 21:30.

events.title: Claudia Leitte - Turnê Intemporal
events.summary: Claudia Leitte brought the more intimate Intemporal project to Vivo Rio on March 13, 2026. The venue page lists the event with an axé classification and a 22:00 show time.

events.title: Pistuxa x Hausu no Trauma
events.summary: São Paulo party Pistuxa linked with Baixada Fluminense collective Hausu for a club night at TRAUMA in Centro. Resident Advisor listed Valesuchi b2b Lucas Kid, D.Silvestre, and Da Bomb b2b Levas from March 13 at 22:00 to March 14 at 05:00.

events.title: Guilherme Arantes - 50 Anos-Luz
events.summary: Guilherme Arantes celebrated 50 years of career with the 50 Anos-Luz tour at Vivo Rio. Ticketmaster confirmed the March 14, 2026 presentation at 22:00.

events.title: Alceu Valença - 80 Girassóis
events.summary: Alceu Valença opened the Rio date of his 80 Girassóis celebration at Farmasi Arena. The venue page confirms March 14, 2026 with doors at 19:00 and show time at 21:00.

events.title: Steve Hackett & Genetics - The Best of Genesis Tour 2026
events.summary: Steve Hackett appeared with Genetics at Vivo Rio on the The Best of Genesis Tour 2026. The venue page listed March 21, 2026 at 21:00, with the show built around Genesis-era classics.

events.title: Baco Exu do Blues - HASOS Show Tour
events.summary: Baco Exu do Blues brought the HASOS Show Tour to Farmasi Arena. The venue confirmed Saturday, March 21, 2026, with doors at 20:00 and show time at 22:00.

events.title: Chicago Legacy - Danny Seraphine
events.summary: Chicago Legacy, led by founding Chicago drummer Danny Seraphine, played Qualistage in Rio. Ticketmaster listed the March 27, 2026 performance at 21:30.

events.title: As Vozes - Péricles e Ferrugem
events.summary: Péricles and Ferrugem teamed up for As Vozes at Farmasi Arena. The venue page confirmed March 28, 2026, with doors at 20:00 and show time at 22:00.

events.title: Rave In Rio - Ep8, Vidigal
events.venueName: Rua Major Toja Martinez Filho, 126 - Vidigal
events.summary: Rave In Rio returned for Ep8 in Vidigal with a lineup including Soppa, Crazy Jeff, Vazz, ZN1, and Remixia. Shotgun listed the event for March 29, 2026 from 18:00 to 02:00.

data.notes: Focused on verified December 2026 Rio listings from RA, Shotgun, Ticketmaster and local agenda pages, excluding obvious arena-scale concerts where possible.

events.title: Rio Réveillon 2027 — 20th Anniversary at Jockey Club
events.summary: Rio Réveillon marks its 20th anniversary at Jockey Club Brasileiro with Bom Gosto, Fica Comigo, samba-school drums and DJs. Music is confirmed to run from 21:00 on 31 December 2026 until 05:00 on 1 January 2027.

events.title: Réveillon do Morro 2027 — ESPETACUL.AR
events.venueName: SkyPark | Parque Bondinho Pão de Açúcar
events.summary: Réveillon do Morro celebrates 30 years with an all-inclusive New Year’s Eve event at Morro da Urca and Pão de Açúcar access tiers. The event page confirms DJs, shows and performances across two main SkyPark dance floors, with the full lineup still to be announced.

events.title: RARA Alto Verão
events.venueName: SkyPark | Parque Bondinho Pão de Açúcar
events.summary: RARA Alto Verão returns to SkyPark at Parque Bondinho Pão de Açúcar on 27 December. The page frames it as a house-music party at the top of Rio, with international and local names promised for the lineup.

events.title: Réveillon BLK Rio 2027
events.summary: Réveillon BLK Rio returns to Marina da Glória for its second edition with an all-inclusive premium New Year’s party. The listed confirmed attractions include DEADLINE, BEWAV, Alisson Nunes, Jair Sandoval and Luan Poffo.

events.title: SOME Festival presents: Pre-NYE with ARTBAT / Rio de Janeiro
events.summary: SOME Festival’s pre-New Year’s Eve gathering brings Ukrainian duo ARTBAT to Jardins do MAM with a curated support program and frontstage/backstage ticket tiers.

events.title: Kid Abelha — Eu Tive Um Sonho
events.summary: Kid Abelha's Rio show is confirmed for 11 December 2026 at Brava Arena Jockey after a date and venue update. The concert is scheduled for 20:00 with gates at 18:00.

events.title: Kevin Pré-Réveillon Rio de Janeiro 29/12 c/ Clementaum
events.summary: Festa KEVIN’s pre-NYE Rio edition takes over The Home with two dancefloors and Clementaum, leaning into a queer, sweaty house/techno/electro-house end-of-year sound.

events.title: SVRVRV Bridge RJ
events.summary: Rio-born queer dance platform SVRVRV hosts Brooklyn DJ BRIDGE on the final Rio stop of a Brazil tour, foregrounding Black house roots, disco, Chicago house, Latin house and Afro house.

events.title: Ferrugem — Sentimento audiovisual recording
events.summary: Ferrugem records an audiovisual project for Sentimento at Qualistage, presenting material from the album plus career hits and new songs.

events.title: HOLE: Última Do Anvs 2026
events.summary: HOLE closes its 2026 season with DJs, performances and a no-photo queer club format in Saúde, tagged across tech house, tribal house, house, dance and pop.

events.title: Jota Quest at Brava Arena Jockey
events.summary: Jota Quest plays Brava Arena Jockey on 12 December 2026. The Ticketmaster listing confirms a 20:00 show time and 18:00 gate opening.

events.title: Chá da Alice 17 Anos
events.summary: Long-running Brazilian pop/funk/axé party brand Chá da Alice marks 17 years with a late-December Rio edition at Sacadura 154.

events.title: Barão Vermelho no Circo Voador
events.summary: Barão Vermelho’s year-end Circo Voador show is confirmed for 19 December, with the Do Tamanho da Vida tour. The event page calls the final-of-year Circo date a tradition and lists classic hits alongside newer songs.

events.title: Di Ferrero + Charlie Brown Jr. Acústico at Qualistage
events.summary: Di Ferrero and Thiago Castanho & Marcão Britto’s Charlie Brown Jr. Acústico share a Qualistage bill on 19 December. The night pairs Di Ferrero’s SE7E tour with acoustic versions of Charlie Brown Jr. material.

events.title: Ponto de Equilíbrio no Circo Voador
events.summary: Rio reggae band Ponto de Equilíbrio returns to Circo Voador for a career-spanning show. The Eventim page highlights classics including “Árvore do Reggae” and “Aonde Vai Chegar.”

events.title: Barko Abrindo O Verão
events.summary: KBRAL’s Barko opens Rio summer with a Marina da Glória boat/day-party format blending baile funk and techno, pitched as a hot, wet, dancefloor-led December return.

events.title: Capital Inicial at Brava Arena Jockey
events.summary: Brasília pop-rock band Capital Inicial performs at Brava Arena Jockey, with the show listed for 20:00 and gates at 18:00.

events.title: Roberta Sá no Circo Voador
events.summary: Roberta Sá performs at Circo Voador on 12 December 2026, with the event listed for 20:00. The show brings a major contemporary samba/MPB voice to one of Rio’s defining live venues.

events.title: Xuxa — O Último Voo da Nave
events.summary: Xuxa brings the stadium-scale “O Último Voo da Nave” show to Maracanã on 20 December 2026 at 19:00, with the event page listing 30e as promoter and tickets via Eventim.

events.title: CARIOCA New Year Festival 2026/2027
events.summary: The New World/TNW’s weeklong queer circuit festival returns around New Year, promising multi-day productions, circuit DJs, stage shows, dancers, and large-scale LGBTQ+ party programming across Rio.

events.title: Réveillon Tropical 2027
events.summary: Maré Ticket lists Réveillon Tropical at Brava Arena Jockey on 31 December 2026, with Anitta billed alongside Fica Comigo, +5521, Adorofrozen Crew with John Faily, Yasmin Vilhena and more.

events.title: Réveillon Sirena Rio 2027
events.summary: The Sirena electronic-party brand lands at Marina Rio Lounge for a Rio NYE edition, with Evokings, Gustavo Mota, Fancy Inc, Mell Garcia, Miracle, and Purple Crew listed as confirmed attractions.

events.title: Réveillon Maravilha 2027 com Belo
events.summary: Ticket360 lists Réveillon Maravilha 2027 with Belo at MAM Rio on 31 December 2026, opening at 21:00, with all-inclusive ticket areas.

events.title: Altar De Copa 2027: A New Year's Eve Above Copacabana
events.venueName: Alma Copacabana Rooftop Pool & Wellness Club
events.summary: An intimate rooftop NYE above Copacabana, sold via Shotgun, with a music journey advertised around Brazilian rhythms, carnival energy, electronic sounds, premium open bar, and sunrise breakfast.

events.title: White Rooftop Reveillon 2027 | Santa Teresa Collection
events.summary: A White Rooftop/Party Network NYE pre-registration on Shotgun, billed as an intimate all-inclusive house party above Rio in a historic Santa Teresa house.

events.title: Réveillon Seu Vidal
events.summary: A local all-inclusive NYE party on Ilha Itanhangá with the music direction announced across hip-hop, funk, pagode, and electronic, though individual attractions are still to be announced.

data.notes: January 2027 in Rio is anchored by New Year’s spillover, major stadium rock, electronic sunset parties, and the first confirmed wave of pre-Carnival samba programming.

events.title: System of a Down + Faith No More

events.title: STEREOLAB Japan Tour 2026
